zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.6**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.5** 为对比基线，带来窗口管理原生 Fluent 界面与等比磁吸画布升级、独立「快捷键一览」菜单、「文本识别与翻译」全新重构、PPT 全屏演示免打扰豁免、更克制的出厂默认配置，以及 Scoop 软链与 `Ctrl+Shift+Esc` 任务管理器快捷键两项高优先级问题根治：

sections.title: 窗口管理原生 Fluent 视觉升级与等比磁吸画布
items: **窗口速切器（`Alt+Tab`）、双层分屏布局管理器与工作区捕获/进度浮窗**全面升级为原生 Fluent 视觉体系，完美跟随系统浅色/深色主题与动态主题色实时热切换，锁屏与远程桌面场景稳定无黑屏；
**速切器操控全面提速**：常驻极简底部检索栏、行内 `1–9` 数字键帽直达切窗、按住 `Alt` 直接键入字母筛选，彻底杜绝偶尔漏切回系统原生 `Alt+Tab`；
**焦点边框与置顶边框零滞后零残影**：拖拽或缩放窗口瞬间隐身零拖影、松手严丝合缝贴合，窗口最小化或收入托盘时即时消失不留残影，且绝不遮挡右键菜单与输入法候选框；
**分屏自由画布编辑器重塑**：告别宽屏压扁变形，升级为按当前显示器真实长宽比 1:1 居中呈现的通透画布，支持真实像素 + 百分比双标注、8 方向拖边缩放、磁吸对齐参考线（按住 `Alt` 临时关闭）、一键整理防重叠、复制区域以及右上角一键直达真实桌面 1:1 全屏编辑；
**工作区吸顶预览与手势深度联动**：工作区编辑页支持微缩桌面舞台吸顶常驻联动高亮，并新增 **6 项参数化窗口管理手势命令**，画手势即可直接切换指定分屏布局或一键启动指定工作区。

sections.title: 独立「快捷键一览」与「文本识别与翻译」全面重构
items: **独立「快捷键一览」一级菜单**：将原深埋在通用设置里的快捷键面板升级为侧边栏「系统总控」固定第 3 菜单，内置关键词即时搜索，快速查改全站所有模块快捷键；同步优化云端备份卡片紧凑布局与全站弹窗层叠顺序，彻底解决标题栏遮挡更新日志/反馈弹窗的问题；
**「文本识别与翻译」3 页签重构**：划词翻译升级为 **「免费 AI 翻译 / 免费双源极速 / 自有 API 与本地模型」** 3 选 1 场景卡片，默认零配置开箱即用、彻底隐藏开发者字段，极客仍可按需展开 OpenAI / DeepSeek / Gemini / DeepL / 本地 Ollama 完整配置，并在底部提供一屏可见即时测试条；
**离线 OCR 引导基于实测精准分级**：`PP-OCRv6` 推荐包（约 30 MB）即可覆盖日常截图、文档表格、多语种与实拍照片，另提供按需下载的高精度精修包满足疑难细节识别需求。

sections.title: 全屏免打扰支持 PPT 演示豁免、更克制的出厂默认配置
items: **全屏免打扰统一命名与 PPT 放映豁免**：全站同类开关统一精简命名为「全屏免打扰」（8 语种同步）；PowerPoint、WPS 演示与 LibreOffice Impress 全屏放映时，**自动保留按键回显、鼠标聚光灯、截图、录屏与全局快捷键**，仅默认避让鼠标手势以保护原生右键翻页/激光笔菜单；
**新安装更轻量无打扰**：全新安装默认不开启远控增强、文件占用解锁、Caps 引导改键、窗口管理与空格预览 5 项进阶模块（零后台占用，可在「设置 -> 功能模块」随时按需开启；覆盖升级完整保留老用户原有开关），并为 Caps 引导改键补充对输入法切换习惯的清晰提示；
**安装完成页精修**：删减安装器冗余引导语，提供更简洁实用的 8 语种快速上手提示。

sections.title: 关键社区反馈修复
items: **修复 `Ctrl+Shift+Esc` 打开 Windows 任务管理器失效的问题** (#38, @zmj159809)：彻底修复带修饰键的 `Esc` 组合键被错误触发修饰键重置，导致无法唤起系统任务管理器、在微信误关窗或在 Chrome 误弹浏览器任务管理器的问题；
**彻底修复 Scoop 安装后无法保存配置与识别不到内置组件的问题** (#37, @zmj159809)：在不降低任何路径安全防护的前提下，原生兼容 Scoop 的 `current` 与 `.tools3000` 双层目录联接，覆盖配置写入、插件加载、窗口管理、Picasa 看图器与搜索服务全部路径，同时保持开机自启跨版本平滑升级，无需手动配置环境变量。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.6** (compared against **v1.5.5**). This release refines the **Window Manager** experience with a native Fluent UI and magnetic proportional zone canvas, introduces a standalone **Shortcuts Overview** page and a redesigned **OCR & Translation** workspace, adds **PowerPoint / slideshow exemption** to Fullscreen Do Not Disturb, keeps fresh installs lighter by default, and resolves two high-impact community-reported issues:

sections.title: Native Fluent Window Manager Polish & Magnetic Proportional Zone Canvas
items: Upgraded **Quick Switch (`Alt+Tab`)**, the **Dual-Layer SnapZones Layout Hub**, and **Workspace capture/launch overlays** to a crisp native Fluent UI with instant light/dark and accent-color hot sync, zero blank frames across lock screens / RDP, and an ultra-responsive dedicated input pipeline with `1–9` direct switching and instant bottom search.

Always-on-top and focus borders now hide cleanly during drag/resize and snap flush on release with zero lag, zero ghost borders when apps minimize to tray, and proper Z-order below context menus and IME candidates.

Rebuilt the embedded **SnapZones Canvas Editor** around your display's true aspect ratio with pixel + percentage labels, translucent glass layering, 8-handle resizing, Figma-style magnetic snap guides (hold `Alt` to bypass), one-click tidy layout, duplicate zone, and one-click jump to the 1:1 fullscreen desktop editor.

Added a sticky interactive preview dock in the Workspace editor and **6 parameterized Window Manager mouse gesture commands** that can directly switch to a named SnapZones layout or launch a specific Workspace.

sections.title: Standalone Shortcuts Overview & Redesigned OCR / Translation Workspace
items: Promoted **Shortcuts Overview** to a dedicated top-level menu under System Control with instant keyword filtering across all modules; refined Cloud Backup card layout and unified modal Z-index layering so the titlebar never overlaps dialogs.

Reorganized **OCR & Translation** into 3 clear tabs with a progressive 3-choice translation selector (**Free AI Translation**, **Free Fast Dual-Source**, or **Custom API / Local Ollama**), hiding developer fields for everyday users while keeping full custom provider flexibility and a built-in one-click test bar.

Updated offline OCR package guidance across all 8 languages based on real-world benchmarks (`PP-OCRv6` ~30 MB recommended pack for everyday screenshots, documents, and photos, plus an optional high-precision refinement pack).

sections.title: PPT Slideshow Exemption, Lighter Fresh Installs & Unified Naming
items: Unified all related toggles under **Fullscreen Do Not Disturb** across 8 languages, and exempted **PowerPoint / WPS Presentation / LibreOffice Impress** slideshows so Keycast, Mouse Spotlight, Screenshot, Screen Recording, and global hotkeys remain fully available during presentations (while still stepping aside for native right-click slide menus).

Fresh installs now keep **Remote Boost**, **File Locksmith**, **Caps Layer**, **Window Manager**, and **Spacebar QuickLook** disabled by default for zero background overhead until opted in (upgrades preserve all existing user toggles), added clear input-habit guidance on Caps Layer, and streamlined the 8-language installer finish tips.

sections.title: Critical Community Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where pressing `Ctrl+Shift+Esc` failed to open Windows Task Manager (and could trigger bare `Esc` in WeChat or Chrome's browser task manager instead) (#38, @zmj159809).

Fixed Scoop installations failing to save configuration or failing to detect bundled binaries behind Scoop's `current` and `.tools3000` directory junctions — now works cleanly out of the box with no environment variable workarounds (#37, @zmj159809).

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.5**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.4** 为对比基线，带来全新进化的 **窗口管理套件 v2.0**（延续出厂默认全关闭设计，未开启时零进程、零钩子、零内存占用），全面重构分屏布局、工作区一键快照与增强 `Alt+Tab` 切换体验，并针对多显示器热插拔、虚拟桌面及 Windows 10 / Windows 11 / Windows Server 2019–2025 全场景做了系统级加固：

sections.title: 分屏布局 v2（SnapZones）：双层共视布局管理器与 6 大参数化模板
items: 全新上线 **双层共视布局管理器**（支持从 `设置 -> 窗口管理` 或全局热键一键唤起）：底层直接全屏实时透视当前分屏分区，顶层悬浮卡片控制台实时切换布局、增减分区数量或开关分区间距，所见即所得；
内置 **6 套参数化模板**（无布局、焦点、列、行、网格、优先级网格），支持自定义布局复制与 1:1 全屏精细编辑、**0–9 数字布局快捷键**一键切换与冲突自动消解，以及横屏/竖屏默认布局自适应；
新增**多屏与虚拟桌面拓扑自愈**：外接显示器拔出时自动保留历史绑定配置（插回即恢复），已删除的虚拟桌面绑定支持在设置页一键扫描并安全清理。

sections.title: 工作区 v2（Workspaces）：正红边框实时摆拍、双层微缩预览舞台与桌面快捷方式
items: 点击 **创建工作区** 后，系统将在所有活动显示器外缘拉起清晰的 `4px` 正红取景细边，方便你先将桌面窗口摆放到理想位置再一键捕获，精准记录当前虚拟桌面内所有窗口的真实彩色图标、启动参数、管理员权限标识、最小化窗还原位置及所属分屏槽位；
捕获与编辑界面全面升级为 **双层交互式桌面与任务栏微缩舞台**：鼠标悬停在应用列表或微缩预览窗口上可实时双向高亮联动，展开手风琴面板即可逐项精调管理员启动、命令行参数、窗口状态、精确坐标、分屏槽位、置顶与透明度；
支持为任意工作区一键生成 **桌面快捷方式 (`.lnk`)** 双击直达启动；从多屏桌面切回单屏笔记本时，自动按比例折叠落位至主屏绝不丢窗，并配备轻量原生启动进度浮窗。

sections.title: 窗口速切器 v2（`Alt+Tab`，参考开源项目 AltTabio）：自由拖缩双栏中枢与独立同应用 `Alt+\``
items: 核心交互与窗口控制思路参考自 GitHub 开源项目 **vibeslop/AltTabio**（MIT 开源协议），并结合 Tools3000 架构完成原生融合与功能扩展；
增强 `Alt+Tab` 切换器升级为可自由掌控的双栏中枢，支持 **8 方向边角自由缩放、顶栏拖动定位、列表与预览分割线调宽，以及跨屏位置记忆**（拔掉外接屏时自动安全拉回主屏）；
新增 **桌面原位投影预览**、中文拼音首字母与模糊秒搜、完整窗口操作快捷键（`F4`–`F9` 窗口控制、`P` 置顶、`Z` 最大化/还原、`T` 收纳托盘及系统托盘窗捞回）；
新增 **独立同应用切窗（`Alt+\``）轨道**：即使不接管 Windows 原生 `Alt+Tab`，也可以单独开启 `Alt+\`` 在同一软件的多个窗口间极速切换。

sections.title: 鼠标手势联动与全版本 Windows 轻量守护
items: 在鼠标手势内置命令中新增 **6 项窗口管理专属动作**（打开双层布局管理器、启动/摆拍工作区、呼出窗口速切器、切换置顶与循环透明度），与手势流无缝衔接；
全链路兼容 **Windows 10 (1809+)、Windows 11、Windows Server 2019 / 2022 / 2025 及远程桌面（RDP）**，实测冷启动仅约 `50 ms`，闲置冷路径回收后物理工作集回落至 **`0.5 MB` 以内**。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.5** (compared against **v1.5.4**). This release delivers a comprehensive **Window Manager v2** upgrade — still **completely disabled by default** (zero background processes, zero hooks, zero RAM until you opt in) — bringing a dual-layer visual layout manager, red-frame workspace capture with interactive desktop & taskbar previews, a freely resizable `Alt+Tab` switcher plus standalone same-app `Alt+\`` switching, and seamless multi-monitor / virtual-desktop resilience across Windows 10, Windows 11, and Windows Server 2019–2025:

sections.title: SnapZones v2: Dual-Layer Visual Layout Hub & 6 Parametric Templates
items: Launch the new **Dual-Layer Layout Manager** directly from `Settings -> Window Manager` or via hotkey (`Win+Shift+~`): see semi-transparent snap zones live across your full desktop while adjusting templates, zone counts, and spacing right on top.

Ships with **6 built-in parametric templates** (No Layout, Focus, Columns, Rows, Grid, and Priority Grid), custom layout duplication & 1:1 fullscreen visual editing, **0–9 instant layout hotkeys** with conflict protection, and automatic landscape/portrait defaults per monitor.
Offline monitors are safely preserved instead of lost when docking/undocking, and bindings for deleted virtual desktops can be audited and cleaned up in one click.

sections.title: Workspaces v2: Red-Frame Capture, Interactive Preview Stage & One-Click Desktop Shortcuts
items: Clicking **Create Workspace** now frames every active monitor with a crisp `4px` crimson capture border so you can arrange your real desktop live and capture your current virtual desktop snapshot (with real app icons, launch arguments, administrator elevation flags, minimized window positions, and matched SnapZones).

Inspect and fine-tune workspaces in the new **interactive miniature desktop & taskbar preview stage** — hovering any app row or preview tile highlights it live, with accordion controls for launch arguments, elevation, window state, exact bounds, SnapZone slot, always-on-top, and opacity.

Generate standalone **Desktop Shortcuts (`.lnk`)** to launch any workspace in one double-click, with automatic multi-monitor collapse fallback when switching from multi-screen desks to a single laptop screen and a lightweight floating launch progress card.

sections.title: Quick Switch v2 (`Alt+Tab`, inspired by vibeslop/AltTabio): Freely Resizable Hub & Standalone Same-App `Alt+\``
items: Interaction design and core window-switching ideas are credited to the open-source GitHub project **vibeslop/AltTabio** (MIT License), natively integrated and extended for Tools3000.

The enhanced `Alt+Tab` switcher now opens in a roomy dual-pane layout that supports **8-direction edge/corner resizing, titlebar dragging, adjustable list/preview split ratio, and cross-monitor position memory** (with automatic rescue if a remembered monitor is disconnected).

Added **in-place desktop position preview**, Chinese Pinyin initial & fuzzy filtering, full keyboard/button window controls (`F4`–`F9`, `P` pin, `Z` maximize/restore, `T` minimize to tray, plus tray-window recovery), and a **standalone `Alt+\`` same-app window switcher** that works independently even if you prefer to keep Windows' built-in `Alt+Tab`.

sections.title: Window Management Mouse Gestures & Broad Windows Compatibility
items: Added **6 built-in mouse gesture commands** for Window Manager (Dual-Layer Layout Hub, Capture Workspace, Launch Workspace, Quick Switch, Toggle Always-on-Top, and Cycle Opacity).
Engineered and verified across **Windows 10 (1809+), Windows 11, Windows Server 2019 / 2022 / 2025, RDP, x64, and ARM64**, with cold-path memory trimming returning idle working set to under `1 MB`.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.4**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.3** 为对比基线，围绕社区用户的实机视频与使用反馈，专项打磨了**鼠标聚光灯**的退场流畅度与摇晃唤醒抗误触体验：

sections.title: 彻底解决取消聚光灯时退场放大特效掉帧问题
items: 彻底修复晃动鼠标或双击 `Ctrl` 唤出聚光灯后，取消退出时圆圈扩张放大特效偶发掉帧、帧率减半或末尾衔接不够柔顺的问题；
优化全屏聚光灯暗幕、扩散水波光环与垂直同步节拍，无论常规尺寸还是 4K 高分屏、大尺寸聚光灯下，退场放大过程全程保持屏幕原生高刷满帧丝滑过渡。

sections.title: 重构「摇晃鼠标寻光标」抗误触体验并新增最小移动距离设置
items: 彻底解决此前日常快速斜向移动鼠标或轻微手抖时，即使将摇晃阈值调高到 `10` 次仍容易误弹出聚焦圈的痛点；
在 `设置 -> 鼠标聚光灯 -> 摇晃鼠标` 中新增 **最小移动距离** 配置项（默认 `400 px`，支持 `100 ~ 2000 px` 自由调节，自动适配多屏 DPI 缩放），仅在快速、大幅度主动来回晃动鼠标时精准触发；
日常慢速移动、细微抖动以及按住鼠标按键框选、拖拽窗口或划动鼠标手势期间自动静默，告别误触打扰。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.4** (compared against **v1.5.3**). This release focuses on polishing the **Mouse Spotlight** experience based on real-world community feedback, making shake-to-find rock-solid against accidental triggers and ensuring the dismiss expansion animation runs at full native refresh rate with zero frame drops:

sections.title: Zero-Stutter Spotlight Dismiss Expansion Animation
items: Completely eliminated frame drops, 30 FPS half-rate lockups, and abrupt final-frame flashes when dismissing the Mouse Spotlight (whether triggered by shaking the mouse or double-tapping `Ctrl`).

Rebuilt the fullscreen spotlight mask, expanding ripple rings, and VSync frame pacing so dismiss animations stay silky-smooth at your monitor's full native refresh rate — even on 4K high-DPI displays and with large spotlight sizes.

sections.title: Anti-False-Trigger Mouse Shake Detection & Configurable Minimum Shake Distance
items: Redesigned the shake-to-find cursor detector to eliminate accidental triggers during everyday fast diagonal cursor sweeps, tiny hand jitters, slow browsing, and click-and-drag selections or mouse gestures.

Added a new **Minimum Move Distance** setting under `Settings -> Mouse Spotlight -> Shake Mouse` (`100–2000 px`, default `400 px`, automatically DPI-normalized across displays) so you can fine-tune exactly how vigorous a shake is required to summon the spotlight.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.3**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.2** 为对比基线，紧急修复了 `v1.5.2` 在开启鼠标点击光圈、鼠标轨迹或使用鼠标手势时可能拦截鼠标点击的问题，同时 100% 完整保留 `v1.5.2` 的零掉帧与低显存优化：

sections.title: 紧急修复开启「显示点击光圈 / 鼠标轨迹」后鼠标左键被拦截失灵的问题
items: 彻底修复 `v1.5.2` 开启鼠标点击光圈或鼠标流光轨迹后，透明特效浮层未对跨进程窗口完全穿透，导致设置页开关点不回去、系统托盘菜单及其他软件点击无响应的问题；
同步修复鼠标手势轨迹浮层在淡出瞬间可能拦截跨应用点击的同类隐患；
修复后 100% 完整保留 `v1.5.2` 的硬件垂直同步零掉帧渲染管线与低显存占用，不会引入任何掉帧回退。

sections.title: 修复快速连点鼠标时点击光圈被提前中断的问题
items: 修复在点击光圈播放期间（约 380ms 内）连续点击左键或双击时，前一次光圈被误清、第二次点击波纹未正常显示的问题，现在每次连点与双击均能清晰独立呈现。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.3** (compared against **v1.5.2**). This urgent hotfix resolves a click-through regression introduced in `v1.5.2` when Mouse Click Ripples, Pointer Trails, or Mouse Gesture overlays are active, while preserving 100% of the `v1.5.2` zero-stutter performance and low-VRAM architecture:

sections.title: Fixed Mouse Clicks Being Blocked When Click Ripples or Pointer Trails Are Enabled
items: Fixed a regression in `v1.5.2` where enabling **Show Click Ripple** or **Show Pointer Trail** caused the topmost effect overlay to intercept mouse button release and subsequent clicks across Settings, the system tray menu, and other applications.

Restored full cross-process mouse and touch click-through across both Mouse Effects and Mouse Gesture overlays while keeping the zero-stutter VSync hardware SwapChain and low-VRAM memory optimizations completely intact.

sections.title: Fixed Rapid Double-Clicks Cutting Off Click Ripple Animations
items: Fixed an edge case where clicking a second time within the active ripple duration (~380 ms) prematurely dismissed the ripple overlay instead of rendering each rapid click cleanly.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.2**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.1** 为对比基线，重点根治桌面特效与鼠标手势掉帧、截图另存为假死、Windows 10/Server 离线识字为空与模型包下载偶发卡死等高频痛点，并全面上线识字与翻译深度链路实时进度反馈：

sections.title: 鼠标聚光灯、全系列桌面特效与鼠标手势高负载零掉帧升级
items: **全系列桌面特效告别掉帧**：全面重构鼠标聚光灯、光环、点击水波纹、移动流光轨迹、按键回显、Toast 气泡提示与焦点缩放的渲染节奏与垂直同步机制，丝滑适配 60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz 高刷显示器；
**全系统新老机型无缝自适应**：自动识别 Windows 10、Windows 11、Windows Server 2016–2025、远程桌面（RDP）以及早期核显与虚拟显卡环境，智能择优启用硬件合成或高兼容渲染管线，免手动配置；
**鼠标手势高负载顺滑且显存直降 94%**：升级局部动态画布与防 CPU 抢占调度机制，CPU 满载时绘制手势依然跟手不卡顿，活跃期显存占用较旧版直降约 94%，静默后自动彻底归零释放。

sections.title: 修复截图「另存为」程序无响应、强杀才弹出保存框的问题
items: 彻底修复截图过程中点击「另存为」时，因系统文件保存对话框被截图置顶遮罩压住而导致界面看似卡死无响应、直到结束进程才弹出保存窗口的问题；
现在触发保存前截图选区会优雅让出置顶层级，系统保存对话框即点即弹，同时继续隔离第三方网盘或系统外壳扩展对主程序的干扰。

sections.title: 彻底修复 Windows 10 / Server 离线识字永远提示「未识别到文字」的问题
items: 根治在未预装新版系统 GPU 推理运行时的 Windows 10、Windows Server 2016–2025 及早期 Windows 11 系统中，即便已下载全部离线模型包、无论如何截图均提示「未识别到文字」的兼容性问题；
无需增加安装包体积，不支持系统 GPU 加速的环境会自动无缝切换至高兼容性本地深度识别模式并支持自动容错恢复，让全系列 Windows 系统均可开箱稳定使用离线高精度文字识别与原位翻译。

sections.title: 全球双栈自适应离线模型下载引擎与透明进度显示
items: **海内外镜像自动竞速与智能切源**：下载离线文字识别包、多语种扩展包与 AI 背景修复模型时，自动根据当前网络环境在中国大陆与全球镜像源之间快速择优；
**防卡死看门狗、断点续传与秒级取消**：遇到单节点断流或龟速停滞时自动切换备用节点并支持断点续传，不再干等数分钟；点击取消时毫秒级响应中断；
**下载状态全透明**：设置页离线引擎区实时显示当前阶段、实时网速、已下载体积、当前镜像节点及自动切源提示，下载进度一目了然。

sections.title: 文字识别与翻译长耗时深度链路实时阶段反馈
items: 常规快速识别与翻译依然保持零打扰瞬时出结果；
当任务进入离线引擎冷加载、老系统兼容深度识别、高精度/多行深度识字、低置信度精修、多语种扩展包自动复核，或翻译分批处理、网络波动自动重试、自动切换备用翻译源以及 AI 背景纹理修复等耗时环节时，识字结果窗、贴图等待胶囊与全局划词翻译浮窗（`Alt+X`）均会实时呈现清爽矢量加载动效与精确阶段说明，消除等待盲区。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.2** (compared against **v1.5.1**). This major smoothness, compatibility, and responsiveness release eliminates visual frame drops across desktop effects and mouse gestures, fixes Windows 10/Server offline OCR and Save As freezes, introduces a resilient global mirror downloader, and adds real-time stage feedback for deep OCR and translation pipelines:

sections.title: **Zero-Stutter Desktop Effects & Low-VRAM Mouse Gestures**
items: Rebuilt frame pacing and rendering across Mouse Spotlight, Halo, Click Ripples, Pointer Trails, Keycast, Toast Notifications, and Cinema Zoom with VSync-aligned scheduling for smooth 60Hz / 120Hz / 144Hz / 240Hz displays.

Added full automatic hardware-tier adaptation across Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2016–2025, Remote Desktop (RDP), legacy integrated GPUs, and software adapters without manual configuration.

Upgraded Mouse Gesture trails to a compact local dynamic canvas with non-spinning high-load pacing, staying fluid even under heavy CPU load while reducing active gesture VRAM usage by ~94% and releasing to zero when idle.

sections.title: **Fixed Screenshot "Save As" Unresponsive Freeze**
items: Fixed an issue where clicking Save As during screenshot capture could cause the system file dialog to be trapped behind the topmost capture overlay, making Tools3000 appear frozen until force-closed.
The capture overlay now cleanly yields topmost focus before launching the isolated system Save As dialog, ensuring instant response and full compatibility with third-party Explorer shell extensions.

sections.title: **Fixed Windows 10 / Server Offline OCR Always Returning "No Text Detected"**
items: Resolved a platform compatibility failure where users on Windows 10, Windows Server 2016–2025, or early Windows 11 builds without the newer system DirectML runtime received empty OCR results even after downloading all offline model packs.

Added a zero-bloat local CPU compatibility fallback engine that activates seamlessly when hardware acceleration is unavailable, delivering accurate offline PP-OCRv6 recognition across all supported Windows versions without increasing installer size.

sections.title: Global Dual-Stack Adaptive Model Downloader & Live Progress
items: Replaced single-endpoint blocking downloads with a resilient multi-mirror downloader that races domestic and global mirrors automatically, detects stalls or slow connections within seconds, switches mirrors seamlessly with HTTP resume support, and cancels almost instantaneously.
Settings now displays transparent live download status including current stage, real-time speed, downloaded size, active mirror host, and automatic mirror switching notices.

sections.title: Real-Time Stage Feedback for Deep OCR & Translation Pipelines
items: Everyday fast-path recognition and translation remain instant and unobtrusive; whenever a request enters a longer pipeline stage—such as cold-loading offline models, CPU compatibility depth mode, high-accuracy multi-line or low-confidence refinement, automatic script switching, batched translation, transient retry, automatic fallback provider switching, or AI background texture inpainting—the OCR Result window, Pinned Screenshot capsule, and Quick Translate popup (`Alt+X`) now display clean vector loading motion and exact live progress text.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.1**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.5.0** 为对比基线，重点解决首次截图进剪贴板慢半拍、宽屏小字识字断断续续的问题，并对全局键盘输入响应与优雅退场做了底层稳定性加固：

sections.title: 首次截图点完成秒进剪贴板
items: **消除首帧复制卡顿**：重构截图完成后的编码与写盘链路，将原先在剪贴板、自动保存与历史记录间重复多次的无损编码合并为单次极速复用，同时将首次启动的历史临时文件清理迁至后台异步执行；
**消除主线程阻塞与提示延迟**：免除自动保存与剪贴板临时文件写入时的同步物理刷盘等待，并将截图结束后的内存紧缩延后至静默冷态执行，点完成瞬间即可流畅弹出提示并秒速粘贴。

sections.title: 修复宽屏小字桌面截图 OCR 漏字断识问题
items: **解除宽图误压缩上限**：修复此前系统内置 Windows OCR 对 2K 及宽屏桌面/ERP 表单截图（如密集财务科目表）强行压缩至 1680px 宽度导致小号细体文字发糊、漏识的问题；
**宽屏小字清晰度增强**：1080p / 2K / 4K 宽图不再误降采样，对中高密度桌面宽图执行温和清晰度增强，大幅提升 Windows OCR 召回率；如需极限小字与复杂表格准确率，也可在设置页一键下载离线高精度 PP-OCRv6 模型包。

sections.title: 全局键盘响应加固、Win11 地址栏避让与彻底清场退出
items: **独立高优先级单键盘输入通道**：将全局键盘监听迁至独立高优先级输入线程并实现无锁热路径分发，同时将文本扩展合并至同一条共享键盘监听总线（整套程序全局仅保留单一键盘钩子），杜绝界面忙碌时波及输入法打字流畅度；
**Caps 引导改键日常打字零感知**：新增空闲态极速直通判断，未按住 `CapsLock` 时所有日常输入按键直接放行，零额外开销；
**Win11 资源管理器空格预览避让加固**：补充对 Windows 11 现代地址栏与搜索框输入焦点的精准识别，避免在输入路径或检索时误触发空格预览；
**彻底根治退出后偶发残留后台进程**：加固程序收尾退场逻辑，在完成全部配置保存、钩子卸载与资源释放后确保进程毫秒级干净清场，杜绝残留进程锁死安装目录影响覆盖升级。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.1** (compared against **v1.5.0**). This stability and responsiveness update eliminates first-screenshot clipboard lag, fixes wide-screen small-text OCR truncation, and hardens system-wide keyboard input responsiveness and clean process exit:

sections.title: **Instant First-Screenshot Clipboard Delivery**
items: Fixed the noticeable delay between clicking Done on the first screenshot after launch and the image appearing in the clipboard.

Eliminated redundant PNG re-encoding across clipboard, auto-save, and screenshot history, moved stale temporary file cleanup off the UI thread, removed blocking disk flushes from auto-save and temporary clipboard files, and deferred post-capture memory trimming so the completion toast and clipboard paste feel instantaneous.

sections.title: Wide-Screen Small-Text OCR Accuracy Fix
items: Fixed an issue where Windows built-in OCR aggressively downscaled wide desktop and ERP screenshots (such as 2K financial tables and dense tree lists) to 1680px width, causing fine small fonts to blur or drop characters.

Preserved full native clarity on 1080p / 2K / 4K screenshots and added gentle upscaling for medium-to-wide dense text screens, significantly improving recall on Windows OCR while keeping high-accuracy offline PP-OCRv6 models available as a 1-click download in Settings.

sections.title: Keyboard Input Responsiveness, Win11 Explorer Guard & Zero-Zombie Exit Hardening
items: Isolated the global keyboard hook onto its own dedicated high-priority input thread with lock-free callback dispatch and merged Text Expander into the single shared keyboard hook bus, preventing UI activity or IME bursts from causing typing stutter.
Added a zero-overhead idle fast path for CapsLayer so everyday typing passes straight through untouched whenever CapsLock is not held.
Hardened QuickLook spacebar detection on Windows 11 File Explorer to safely avoid modern address bar and search box inputs.
Fixed an edge case where exiting Tools3000 could leave a windowless background process behind during final OS teardown, ensuring clean instant exit and smoother in-app updates.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.5.0**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.17** 为对比基线，新增「窗口管理（第一版）」「Caps 引导改键」两大可选效率套件，解决剪贴板多屏定位与固定需求、深度根治 Win10 LTSC / 机械硬盘首次呼出搜索框黑屏，并带来划词翻译、内存策略与更新日志的多项核心升级：

sections.title: 新增「窗口管理」套件（第一版尝鲜）
items: **全项默认关闭，不用即零占用**：独立原生轻量引擎，8 项子能力出厂默认全部关闭（不开启即 0 进程、0 钩子、0 MB 占用），按需开启；
**自定义分屏吸附（SnapZones）**：内置多套经典网格/画布模板，支持多显示器与**按 Windows 虚拟桌面独立绑定不同布局**、按住 `Ctrl` 跨多区合并吸附、拖出分区自动还原原尺寸，并支持一键导入 PowerToys FancyZones 布局；
**1:1 全屏原生可视化布局编辑器**：按 **`Win + Shift + ~`** 或在设置页一键唤起，直接在真实桌面 1:1 拖拽编辑网格与自由画布，支持**一键从当前桌面真实窗口生成布局（快捷键 `C`）**、拖拽自动磁吸底层真实软件窗口边缘与辅助参考线、60 步撤销及退出后冷路径自动释放内存；
**全套窗口效率辅助**：同时提供工作区一键恢复（Workspaces）、AltTabio 风格窗口速切器（Quick Switch，感谢小众软件 @fcpeacock）、窗口置顶与聚焦边框、滚轮调节窗口透明度、`Alt` 任意位置拖动/缩放、多屏离屏救援与窗口收纳至系统托盘。

sections.title: 新增「Caps 引导改键（CapsLayer）」模块
items: **键盘双手不离主位**：按住 `CapsLock` 即可将常用键位映射为方向键、Home/End、翻页、删除或媒体控制；轻按可按偏好保持或切换大小写，随时按 `Shift + CapsLock` 原生切换大小写；
**灵活定制与默认零开销**：内置多套高效预设，支持全局与分应用独立改键方案、运行窗口快速拾取排除，默认关闭零钩子零负担。

sections.title: 剪贴板历史：彻底修复多屏错乱，新增位置与尺寸固定
items: **3 种多屏自适应定位模式**：支持「跟随当前显示器」（默认，自动在光标所在显示器居中弹出）、「记住上次位置与大小」、「固定屏幕位置与尺寸」（原生支持左侧/上方副屏负坐标）；
**跨混合缩放零漂移**：按与 DPI 无关的逻辑尺寸保存宽高，在 100% / 150% / 200% 多屏间自动保持视觉大小一致；拔掉外接副屏时自动按相对位置安全回退至主屏可视区，插回副屏后自动恢复原固定位；
**双入口便捷控制**：剪贴板浮窗标题栏新增一键「固定当前位置与大小」定位图标；设置页新增「窗口位置与尺寸（多屏自适应）」配置卡片，支持一键捕获当前面板位置、微调坐标与宽高、重置默认及开启「锁定位置与尺寸（防误拖动/缩放）」。

sections.title: 深度根治 Win10 LTSC / 机械硬盘首次呼出搜索框黑屏问题
items: **首屏资源瘦身 99%+**：8 国语言词典改为按当前语种按需懒加载，入口主脚本从约 1.94 MB 缩减至约 11 KB，并与目标界面并行加载，大幅削减机械硬盘首次冷启动的磁盘读取与解析耗时；
**后台无感真实首帧预热**：后台预载阶段现会隐身无感完成真实的 GPU 首帧渲染（任务栏与屏幕全程零闪烁、不抢焦点），用户首次按下 `Alt + Space` 即可直接呈现已就绪画面；
**消除提前露黑框与原生骨架兜底**：移除过短的假就绪抢跑定时器与首次破坏性重绘刷新，同步内联首屏同主题底色并升级原生圆角搜索框骨架底衬。

sections.title: `Alt + X` 原生划词翻译升级与「划词翻译」鼠标手势
items: **交互式双语工具栏与记忆偏好**：浮窗顶栏升级为 `[源语种] [一键互译交换] [目标语种]`，支持自动检测与 10 语种独立直选并持久化记忆；修复手动切换目标语种被覆盖、简繁中文互译被跳过及单段长技术文本 AI 翻译偶发超时卡顿问题；
**新增原生「划词翻译」手势与热角命令**：鼠标手势与触发角内置命令新增「划词翻译」，默认采用象形字母 `T` 轨迹（`←→↓`），同时加强 180 度折返手势识别准确度。

sections.title: 「内存策略」全景透明看板、更新日志升级与托盘控制舱扩展
items: **「内存策略」全景透明治理看板**：原性能监控页升级为纯只读、零后台轮询的「内存策略」看板，按 6 大层级透明展示全部 20 项内存上限封顶、按需零驻留与自动回收规则，支持按机制标签快速筛选；
**离线更新日志弹窗体验重构**：升级为按自然日分组时间轴，清晰区分「新增功能 / 优化改进 / 问题修复」计数徽章与分面筛选，支持关键词搜索荧光高亮与简洁/详览切换；
**托盘控制舱全面补齐**：系统托盘快捷开关升级为 12 格 `3x4` 对称布局 + 远控增强（正式纳入「窗口」「改键」「预览」三大模块），精炼短标消除文字截断。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.5.0** (compared against **v1.4.17**). This feature milestone introduces two new opt-in productivity suites (Window Manager v1 and CapsLayer), multi-monitor fixed placement for Clipboard History, a four-layer fix for first-open Search black screens on Windows 10 LTSC / HDDs, upgraded Quick Translate with a native gesture command, and a redesigned Memory Policy overview and Changelog viewer:

sections.title: **New Module: Window Manager Suite (v1 Initial Release — Preview Quality)**
items: *Honest note from the author*: **Window Manager is currently v1 (first playable release)**. Even the author is not fully satisfied with all the rough edges yet — it is usable enough for everyday window tiling and helpers today, and will be steadily refined and improved in future updates. All 8 sub-features default to **OFF** with zero background processes, hooks, or memory footprint until enabled.

Includes customizable **SnapZones** (with multi-monitor & per-Windows-virtual-desktop layout bindings, multi-zone spanning, and 1-click PowerToys FancyZones import), a **1:1 Fullscreen Native Visual Layout Editor** (`Win + Shift + ~`, supporting 1-click capture from real desktop windows and magnetic edge snapping to underlying apps), **Workspaces** launcher, **Quick Switch** AltTabio-style window switcher (thanks to Appinn @fcpeacock), **Always on Top** & **Focus Border**, scroll-wheel **Opacity**, **Alt + Drag / Resize**, and **Multi-Monitor Rescue & Minimize to Tray**.

sections.title: **New Module: CapsLayer Key Remapper (Opt-In, Zero Idle Overhead)**
items: Hold `CapsLock` to turn home-row keys into an instant navigation/editing layer (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Delete, media) while keeping quick tap and `Shift + CapsLock` native escape. Supports built-in presets, global & per-app profiles, and process exclusions.

sections.title: **Clipboard History: Multi-Monitor Adaptive Placement & Fixed Position/Size**
items: Added 3 placement modes: **Follow Active Monitor** (default, centers cleanly on the monitor under your cursor), **Remember Last Position**, and **Fixed Position & Size** (supports negative coordinates for left/upper secondary monitors and an optional drag/resize lock).

Dimensions are persisted in DPI-independent logical units (DIP) so panel size stays visually consistent across 100% / 150% / 200% mixed-DPI setups, with automatic safe fallback to the primary monitor when an external display disconnects.
Added a 1-click **Fix Position & Size** target button directly on the clipboard title bar, synced live with `Settings -> Clipboard History -> Window Position & Size`.

sections.title: **Search Window First-Open Black Screen Fix for Win10 LTSC / HDD**
items: Split all 8 locale dictionaries into on-demand single-language chunks, shrinking the main UI startup bundle by over **99%** (~1.94 MB -> ~11 KB) and loading the active surface in parallel to dramatically cut cold-start disk I/O on HDDs.

Upgraded background preload to silently warm up a real GPU first frame before first summon, removed premature ready timers and destructive first-frame SwapChain resets, and added a matching native search skeleton backdrop.

sections.title: Quick Translate (`Alt + X`) Interactive Language Bar & Native Translate Gesture
items: Upgraded the popup header to `[Source] [Swap] [Target]` with auto-detect, 10 direct target languages, and persistent language memory; fixed manual target overrides, Simplified/Traditional Chinese conversion, and long-paragraph AI timeouts.
Added a native **Quick Translate** built-in command to Mouse Gestures and Hot Corners (default gesture: `L-R-D` / `←→↓` shaped like the letter `T`) with improved 180-degree turn recognition.

sections.title: Memory Policy Transparency Dashboard, Categorized Changelog & Expanded Tray Control Center
items: Rebuilt the memory view into a pure read-only, zero-polling **Memory Policy** dashboard transparently documenting 20 built-in memory caps and reclamation strategies across 6 layers with interactive category filters.
Redesigned the offline **What's New** modal with natural-day timeline grouping, Feature / Improvement / Fix count pills and facet filtering, keyword highlighting, and compact/detailed density toggle.
Expanded the System Tray control grid to a balanced 12-tile (`3x4`) layout now including **Window Manager**, **CapsLayer**, and **QuickLook**, with crisp non-truncated labels.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.17**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.16** 为对比基线，带来针对 Windows 快速启动场景的专项内存与生命周期加固修复：

sections.title: 修复 Windows 快速启动「关机再开机」后搜索索引服务未按需清零的问题
items: **彻底解决关机重启后“未搜文件却见服务常驻”**：Windows 10/11 默认开启「快速启动（混合关机）」，点击「关机」时会注销用户会话，但会把 Session 0 中前一次搜索留下的索引服务进程连同内存一并冻结进休眠镜像，导致下次按电源键开机时旧服务被原样复活；
**全用户注销与系统关机前自动落盘停服**：索引服务现已接入用户会话注销与系统关机事件。当本机所有登录用户均注销（含快速启动关机前自动注销）或系统关机时，服务会先将最新增量文件索引快照安全落盘，再优雅退出，确保**每次关机后再开机都是彻底的 0 索引服务进程、0 MB 占用**，直到您显式按下 `Alt+Space` 搜文件时才会按需启动，且能秒级加载关机前保存的最新快照免重扫全盘；
**日常使用零干扰**：普通锁屏、电脑睡眠/合盖恢复、远程桌面断开不注销、退出重开 Tools3000 主程序，以及多用户电脑仍有其他账号在线时，均完全保持当前会话内秒开常驻不中断。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.17** (compared against **v1.4.16**). This targeted reliability release ensures the on-demand file search service starts completely clean (0 processes, 0 MB) after every Windows shutdown and boot — even when **Windows Fast Startup (Hybrid Shutdown)** is enabled:

sections.title: Clean Search Service Exit on Windows Fast Startup & User Logoff
items: Fixed a Windows Fast Startup edge case where clicking **Shut down** logged off the user session while Windows hibernated Session 0 along with a previously launched File Index Service, causing the old service process to reappear on the next boot before you ever opened Search.

The search service now listens for user session logoff and system shutdown notifications: once all interactive user sessions have logged off (including during Windows Fast Startup shutdown) or the system shuts down, it flushes the latest incremental file index snapshot to disk and stops cleanly.

**Zero impact during normal use**: locking the screen, putting the PC to sleep, disconnecting Remote Desktop without logging off, restarting the Tools3000 main app, or switching accounts while another user stays signed in all keep instant Search warm and responsive.
Because the latest incremental snapshot is flushed cleanly before stopping, the next time you press `Alt+Space` after booting, the search index resumes in seconds without needing a full drive rescan.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.16**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.15** 为对比基线，带来 7 项重点功能进化与高频体验修复：

sections.title: 双击 Ctrl 电影级交互平滑放大
items: **三模式自由选择**：在 `设置 -> 鼠标演示与特效` 中，除保留经典「**聚光灯高亮**」外，全新推出「**电影级平滑放大**」与「**电影级平滑放大 + 光环定位**」两种双击 `Ctrl` 模式（老用户升级后默认保持既有聚光灯习惯，可随时一键切换）。
**电影推拉感与全程可操作兼得**：基于硬件全屏合成与临界阻尼平滑推拉曲线，放大期间**全程支持真实鼠标点击、拖拽、滚动与键盘打字**，告别传统静帧截屏放大无法操作的痛点；内置中心柔和死区跟焦，小范围点击选按钮时画面稳如泰山，光标移近边缘时镜头丝滑平移。
**无级调倍与多重防卡死复位**：放大期间可随时用 `Ctrl + 滚轮`、`Ctrl + + / -` 无级调节倍率（`1.25x ~ 4.0x`），`Ctrl + 0` 一键回默认倍率；支持再次双击 `Ctrl` 或按 `Esc` 退出，并在锁屏、休眠、分辨率/显示器切换或程序退出时自动硬复位至 `1.0x`，闲置零占用。

sections.title: 热键级「按前台应用自动让位」（专业软件零冲突）
items: **单热键精准避让，绝不误伤其他功能**：新增「**单条快捷键按前台应用自动让位**」与「**全局热键免打扰应用名单**」（均支持一键从当前运行窗口拾取），当焦点切入指定专业软件时仅交还对应单条热键给目标程序原生响应，其余快捷键（如 `F1` 截图、`Alt+Space` 搜索）照常生效，切离窗口毫秒级自动恢复。

**开箱自动避让 SSMS / Emacs**：全局划词翻译（默认 `Alt+X`）开箱默认避让 **SQL Server Management Studio (`ssms.exe`)** 与 **Emacs (`emacs.exe` / `runemacs.exe`)**，在 SSMS 中按 `Alt+X` 直接原生执行 SQL 零干扰；用户可随时在 `设置 -> 文本识别与翻译` 或 `设置 -> 通用设置 -> 快捷键总览` 增删避让列表。

sections.title: 修复 `Alt+X` 划词翻译浮窗透明空框与点穿，新增一键切换语种
items: 彻底修复部分环境下按下 `Alt+X` 弹出纯原生翻译浮窗时内容透明不可见、鼠标点击穿透的问题，恢复高对比清晰的即点即译体验；
浮窗顶栏新增**可点击语种方向胶囊**，点击即可在 `自动 -> 中文 -> 英文 -> 日文` 之间循环切换目标语种并就地重新翻译，无需切回设置页。

sections.title: 搜索框 `Ctrl+C` 直接复制文件本体、`Ctrl+Shift+C` 复制路径
items: 对齐系统资源管理器日常肌肉记忆：在 `Alt+Space` 搜索结果中按 `Ctrl+C` 直接将文件/文件夹本体复制到剪贴板（可直接粘贴到任意文件夹或应用），按 `Ctrl+Shift+C` 复制完整路径；
当搜索输入框内拖选了文字时，`Ctrl+C` 仍优先复制所选文字；书签与系统命令等非磁盘项自动降级复制文本。

sections.title: 清除侧边栏「空格快速预览」异常菜单并解耦独立启动
items: 修复 `设置` 侧边栏底部「扩展」区误出现「空格快速预览」幽灵入口且点击落入通用设置页的问题；
解耦「空格快速预览」与「文件搜索」模块的启动依赖，关闭文件搜索时空格快速预览开关依然独立生效。

sections.title: 全软件 8 语种国际化文案润色、新手引导补全与官网双端升级
items: **去地域割裂化**：统一清扫全库 8 国语言提示、右键菜单与演播室导出预设中的特定地域软件与竞品表述，搜索复制统一简洁提示「已复制文件到剪贴板」；
**全触点亮点与加密云同步补齐**：新手引导（Step 0/1/3）、侧边栏副标题、功能模块列表、托盘提示与关于页同步补齐文件/全文/应用/书签/命令全能秒搜、多语离线识字与原位/划词翻译、文件对话框 `Ctrl+G` 快跳即搜、电影级自动运镜录屏、双击 `Ctrl` 交互平滑放大、专业软件自动避让及端到端加密配置云同步亮点；
**官网 PC + 手机双端体验升级**：全面优化官网手机端与桌面端浏览体验，并明确呈现「每个功能均可个性化独立开关，关闭即卸载，零后台占用」的模块化理念。

sections.title: 全链路诊断日志准确性与信噪比加固
items: 修复手势后台执行与电影放大工作线程的 `TraceId` 断链问题，实现单次操作从触发到执行全程单链可追；
消除程序正常退出时连刷无害热键注销告警与设置窗关闭重复日志，收敛日常手势高频中间态日志至 `DEBUG` 级，同时为搜索管道与放大失败补齐系统错误码与多屏边界上下文，大幅提升排障效率。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.16** (compared against **v1.4.15**). This release introduces cinema-grade interactive smooth zoom on Double-Ctrl, per-hotkey foreground app auto-yield (defaulting `Alt+X` to yield to SSMS & Emacs), fixes the `Alt+X` quick-translate popup visibility & adds inline target-language switching, aligns Search `Ctrl+C` to copy real files, removes the stray Spacebar Quick Preview sidebar entry, polishes global 8-language copy & modular website experience, and hardens end-to-end diagnostic logging:

sections.title: Double-Ctrl Cinema Interactive Smooth Zoom
items: Added two new **Double-Ctrl Trigger Modes** alongside the classic spotlight under `Settings -> Mouse FX & Highlights`: **Cinema Smooth Zoom** and **Cinema Smooth Zoom + Halo Ring**.

Delivers video-editor-grade smooth push/pull hardware zoom (zero overshoot, cursor-follow deadzone so clicking stays steady) while keeping native clicking, dragging, and typing 100% functional throughout the zoomed session.

Supports on-the-fly zoom adjustment (`Ctrl + Mouse Wheel`, `Ctrl + +/-`, `Ctrl + 0` reset) between `1.25x` and `4.0x`, instant exit via Double-Ctrl or `Esc`, and multi-layer automatic reset on lock screen, sleep, display change, or exit.

sections.title: Per-Hotkey Foreground App Auto-Yield (Zero Conflict in Pro Apps)
items: Added fine-grained **Per-Hotkey App Auto-Yield** and a **Global Hotkey Do-Not-Disturb App List** under `Settings -> OCR & Translation` and `Settings -> General -> Keyboard Shortcuts`, with a one-click picker for currently running windows.

**Global Quick Translate (`Alt+X`)** now yields automatically out of the box when **SQL Server Management Studio (`ssms.exe`)** or **Emacs (`emacs.exe` / `runemacs.exe`)** is focused, letting `Alt+X` execute SQL or run `M-x` natively while keeping all other Tools3000 shortcuts active and restoring `Alt+X` instantly when you switch away.

sections.title: Fixed `Alt+X` Quick-Translate Popup Visibility & Added One-Click Language Switch
items: Fixed the native `Alt+X` quick-translate popup appearing as an empty translucent frame and passing mouse clicks through on some Windows setups.
Added a clickable target-language direction badge right on the popup header so you can cycle translation targets (`AUTO -> ZH -> EN -> JA -> AUTO`) and re-translate in place without leaving your app.

sections.title: Search `Ctrl+C` Copies Files Directly & `Ctrl+Shift+C` Copies Full Paths
items: Aligned `Alt+Space` Search shortcuts with Windows Explorer muscle memory: press `Ctrl+C` on any file or folder result to copy the file itself (ready to paste directly into folders or apps), and `Ctrl+Shift+C` to copy its full path.
Selecting text inside the search input still copies text normally, and non-file results (bookmarks / system commands) gracefully fall back to copying text.

sections.title: Cleaned Up Sidebar & Decoupled Spacebar Quick Preview Initialization
items: Fixed the built-in **Spacebar Quick Preview** module erroneously appearing at the bottom of the Settings sidebar under Extensions (and falling back to General Settings when clicked).
Decoupled Spacebar Quick Preview startup from the File Search module so Spacebar Quick Preview works reliably even when File Search is disabled.

sections.title: Global 8-Language Copy Polish, Upgraded Onboarding & Modular Website
items: Removed region-specific app mentions across all 8 UI languages, native dialogs, and Studio export presets for a clean international experience.

Updated the welcome onboarding wizard, sidebar subtitles, module descriptions, and official website to clearly highlight omni file/full-text/app/bookmark/command search, in-place & quick translation, `Ctrl+G` file dialog jump, cinema auto-zoom screen recording, Double-Ctrl smooth zoom, pro-app auto-bypass, E2E-encrypted cloud config sync, and independent per-module toggling.

sections.title: Cleaner End-to-End Diagnostic Logs
items: Fixed cross-thread TraceID breaks in gesture execution and cinema zoom sessions, eliminated harmless shutdown/duplicate warnings, reduced routine gesture log noise while keeping full failure context, and added missing OS error codes for faster troubleshooting.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.15**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.14** 为对比基线，带来 10 项重点体验升级与社区反馈修复：

sections.title: 新增离线分页更新日志弹窗与版本历史浏览
items: **升级后自动聚焦展示亮点**：升级至新版本后首次打开设置，自动弹出纯离线「已更新至新版本」对话框；支持跨多版迁移聚合横幅、`本次新增` 微晶徽章、每版精确到分钟的本地发布时间（`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`）与相对时间标签；跨越超过 3 个版本时自动仅展开最新 3 版防止长屏过载。
**关于页常驻归档检索与分页**：在 `设置 -> 洞察与关于 -> 关于` 顶部新增「更新日志」常驻入口，默认首屏展示最新 10 个版本，支持按版本号或关键词即时检索全部内置历史版本，并可按 `+10` 逐页加载更早记录或一键跳转 GitHub Releases。
**全新安装零打扰与偏好双向同步**：全新安装静默记录基线绝不打扰；弹窗左下角与 `设置 -> 通用设置` 同步提供「更新后自动显示更新日志」开关。

sections.title: 消除搜索框首次呼出与休眠恢复瞬间的短暂黑屏闪烁
items: 升级为窗口级原子隐身热身与前端真实首帧就绪握手机制：等待界面完整绘制就绪后再瞬间显形（附超时兜底保护），常规二次呼出仍保持零等待秒开，显著改善 Win10 LTSC 及机械硬盘环境下的打开观感。

sections.title: 修复运行后 Windows 任务栏右键控制菜单失效
items: **任务栏与托盘右键零延迟原生直通**：默认不再于任务栏区域拦截鼠标右键，确保在 Windows 10 / Windows 11 底部主任务栏、副屏任务栏、应用图标控制菜单（关闭窗口/固定/跳转列表）、系统托盘图标、隐藏托盘溢出区及任务栏悬停缩略图上右键点击 100% 稳定弹出原生菜单；
**老用户升级自动生效 & 支持按需手开**：老版本升级后自动平滑迁移生效；如希望在任务栏使用右键手势，仍可随时在 `设置 -> 鼠标手势 -> 作用目标 -> 任务栏` 点亮「右键」触发药丸手动开启；
**全目标独立触发器禁用与现代窗口回放加固**：打通全目标独立触发键禁用开关，并优化现代 WinUI 3 / XAML 窗口短按右键的真实按压节奏回放兼容性。

sections.title: 专业 CAD / UG / EDA / 3D 软件右键自动避让（0ms 原生直通）
items: 新增默认开启的 **「专业 CAD / 3D / EDA 软件右键自动避让」** 保护机制，内置涵盖 33 款高置信度右键密集专业软件清单（包括 AutoCAD、中望 CAD、浩辰 CAD、CAXA、Siemens NX / UG、SolidWorks、CATIA、Creo、Inventor、Fusion、Rhino、Revit、SketchUp、Altium Designer、立创 EDA 专业版、KiCad、Blender、Maya、3ds Max、Cinema 4D、Houdini、ZBrush、Unreal Engine、Unity 等）；
仅在对应专业软件窗口内对**右键**实施 0ms 原生放行（彻底消除拖转视角、平移画布与右键确认卡顿），中键、侧键以及光标移到副屏浏览器时的手势照常可用；在 `设置 -> 鼠标手势` 可随时展开查看完整清单、关闭总开关，或在「应用作用域」对任意单款软件单独覆盖开启。

sections.title: 全新原生轻量划词与剪贴板翻译浮窗（修复 `Alt+X` 不生效）
items: 彻底修复「全局划词与剪贴板翻译快捷键（默认 `Alt+X`）」触发无反应或误跳转不可达外部网页的问题；
全新打造零额外浏览器进程的纯原生轻量翻译浮窗：按下快捷键后优先抓取当前选区文字，未选中时无缝回退翻译剪贴板内容，1ms 在光标旁弹出加载卡片并直接复用内置翻译引擎（默认免密钥 Bilibili Index-Translate + Edge/Google 双源自动容灾），支持图钉固定、拖拽、长译文滚轮、`Ctrl+C` 一键复制译文、失败重试、高分屏缩放与深浅主题色实时同步。

sections.title: 功能模块新增「空格快速预览」独立开关
items: 在 `设置 -> 功能模块 -> 文件检索与系统增强` 中新增独立的 **「空格快速预览」** 开关（支持全局设置搜索直达）；
关闭后立即在底层键盘钩子 0ms 原生放行空格键并同步释放预览窗口内存，方便偏好使用第三方 QuickLook 等预览工具的用户零冲突共存，无需重启即可实时切换。

sections.title: 文件对话框双快捷键纳入全局快捷键总览（单一事实源）
items: 将文件对话框增强的 **「一键跳转当前目录 (`Ctrl+G`)」** 与 **「文件对话框内快捷搜索 (`Ctrl+Shift+G`)」** 统一纳入 `设置 -> 通用设置 -> 快捷键总览` 独立分组，标注「仅对话框生效」场景徽章，与文件对话框设置页双向实时同步，且在普通软件中绝不抢占全局 `Ctrl+G`。

sections.title: 截图原位翻译默认切换为免密钥 Bilibili Index-Translate
items: 截图与贴图原位翻译现已开箱默认启用免密钥 **Bilibili Index-Translate (`Index-Translate-9B`)** 大模型通道；日常翻译如遇公网高峰限流或短暂网络波动，将自动无缝容灾回退至 Edge / Google 免费双源保障不中断，设置页「测试连通性」直报所选通道真实状态。

sections.title: 标注截图缩放跟手度重塑与高分屏矢量缩放光标
items: 彻底修复截图文本框拖拽四角或四边缩放时框体不跟手、字号阶跃跳动及边界死区问题，同步消除画笔、荧光笔、矩形圆角、弯曲箭头、步骤序号及截图选区反复缩放时的累积漂移；
针对 150%+ 高分屏缩放下系统默认缩放光标偏小的问题，全面升级为 4 轴高清矢量双向缩放光标，同步按 DPI 放大标注控制点与命中区。

sections.title: 手机拍屏暗色报错条离线 OCR 增强与「关于 -> 技术栈」实证刷新
items: 增强手机拍摄显示器时底部倾斜、强色偏暗底小字报错条的离线 OCR 完整识别能力，经全量 148 图基准验证清晰数字截图零开销、零回退；
对照当前真实架构与依赖全面刷新 8 国语言「关于 -> 技术栈」卡片（新增 Rust CLI & MCP Server、Rust 剪贴板零依赖内核、MI-GAN 512 离线修复、WinHTTP & DPAPI 翻译网关、quirc 二维码解码、`i18next` 与 `Vite 8.3`，修正系统只读 `WinSQLite3 & zlib`）。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.15** (compared against **v1.4.14**). This release introduces an offline in-app changelog modal after updates, fixes Windows taskbar right-click menus, adds zero-latency right-click auto-bypass for CAD / UG / EDA / 3D apps, launches a native quick-translate popup for `Alt+X`, adds an independent Spacebar Quick Preview toggle, unifies file dialog shortcuts into the Shortcuts overview, eliminates the brief Search black flash, defaults in-place translation to keyless Bilibili Index-Translate, upgrades markup resizing & High-DPI cursors, and enhances dark-bar screen-photo OCR:

sections.title: Offline "What's New" Changelog Dialog & Release History Browser
items: Automatically displays a curated offline highlights dialog the first time Settings opens after an upgrade, showing a multi-version upgrade banner (e.g., `v1.4.11 -> v1.4.15`), `NEW` badges, exact local release dates and times, and relative time pills.

Fresh installs silently record the current version and never pop up an intrusive modal; upgrading across more than 3 versions automatically expands the latest 3 releases while collapsing earlier new entries.

Added a permanent **Changelog** button in `Settings -> Insights & About -> About` displaying the latest 10 releases per page with instant keyword/version search, `+10` pagination, and a direct link to GitHub Releases.
Added a two-way synced **Show changelog after updates** toggle in both the dialog footer and `Settings -> General`.

sections.title: Eliminated Brief Black Flash on First Search Open & Idle Resume
items: Refined Search window presentation so the window stays atomically cloaked until the first visible UI frame is ready (both on first open after preload and when resuming from background suspend or minimize), removing the brief black frame reported on Windows 10 LTSC / HDD setups while keeping warm reopen instantaneous.

sections.title: Fixed Windows Taskbar Right-Click Control Menus Not Opening
items: Right-clicking app icons, system tray icons, the tray overflow flyout, or taskbar window thumbnails now passes through natively with zero interception by default, ensuring Jump Lists and window close/pin menus always open reliably on Windows 10 and Windows 11 (including standard non-admin sessions).

Existing users are automatically migrated on upgrade while keeping full flexibility: power users who want right-click gestures on the taskbar can still re-enable the **Right** trigger pill under `Settings -> Mouse Gestures -> Taskbar` at any time.
Hardened fallback click replay timing for modern WinUI 3 / XAML windows and made per-target trigger disable toggles take effect consistently across all profiles.

sections.title: Auto-Bypass Right-Click in CAD / UG / EDA / 3D Apps (Zero-Latency Passthrough)
items: Added a built-in **Auto-Bypass Right-Click in CAD / 3D / EDA Apps** protection (enabled by default) covering 33 high-confidence right-click-intensive tools including AutoCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD, CAXA, Siemens NX (UG), SolidWorks, CATIA, Creo, Inventor, Fusion, Rhino, Revit, SketchUp, Altium Designer, EasyEDA Pro, KiCad, Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Houdini, ZBrush, Unreal Engine, and Unity.

Only right-click inside the active CAD/3D window rectangle passes through natively with 0ms latency — middle-button, side-button, and secondary-monitor browser gestures continue working smoothly. The built-in list is transparently viewable under `Settings -> Mouse Gestures` and can be toggled off or overridden per app in Scope Targets.

sections.title: Native Quick-Translate Popup for Global Selection & Clipboard Translation (`Alt+X`)
items: Fixed the global **Selection & Clipboard Translation** shortcut (`Alt+X`) failing to respond or opening an unreachable external web page.

Replaced it with a lightweight native Direct2D popup next to the cursor (zero extra browser process) that captures the current selection first and seamlessly falls back to clipboard text, powered by the unified translation engine (keyless Bilibili Index-Translate by default with Edge/Google failover), complete with pinning, dragging, scrolling, one-click `Ctrl+C` copy, retry, High-DPI scaling, and dark/light theme sync.

sections.title: Independent Toggle for Spacebar Quick Preview
items: Added a dedicated **Spacebar Quick Preview** module switch under `Settings -> Plugins -> File Search & System Utilities`.

Turning it off immediately passes Spacebar through at 0ms in the low-level keyboard hook and releases preview window memory, enabling seamless conflict-free coexistence with third-party preview tools such as QuickLook.

sections.title: Unified File Dialog Shortcuts (`Ctrl+G` / `Ctrl+Shift+G`) in General Shortcuts Overview
items: Integrated **Quick Jump to Folder (`Ctrl+G`)** and **File Dialog Quick Search (`Ctrl+Shift+G`)** into `Settings -> General -> Keyboard Shortcuts` under a dedicated **Dialog Enhancer** section with a context badge (`Active in file dialogs`), two-way real-time sync with the Dialog Enhancer page, and zero global hotkey hijacking outside file dialogs.

sections.title: Default In-Place Screenshot Translation to Keyless Bilibili Index-Translate
items: In-place screenshot and pin translation now defaults out of the box to keyless **Bilibili Index-Translate (`Index-Translate-9B`)** with automatic failover to the free Edge / Google channels if the public endpoint encounters temporary rate limiting or network disruption.

sections.title: 1:1 Responsive Screenshot Markup Resizing & High-DPI Vector Resize Cursors
items: Fixed screenshot text boxes lagging, jumping, or detaching from the cursor while resizing, eliminated cumulative drift across all sibling markup tools (pen, highlighter, rounded rectangles, curved arrows, step numbers, and selection edges), and replaced undersized legacy cursors on 150%+ High-DPI displays with crisp 4-axis vector resize cursors.

sections.title: Improved Screen-Photo Dark Error Bar OCR & Refreshed About Page Tech Stack
items: Enhanced offline OCR to recover full text from small, tilted, color-cast dark status/error bars photographed from monitors without regressing clean digital screenshots or benchmark speed.

Updated the **About -> Tech Stack** matrix across all 8 languages to accurately reflect the current architecture (Rust CLI & MCP Server, Rust Clipboard Kernel, MI-GAN 512, WinHTTP/DPAPI gateway, `i18next`, `Vite 8.3`, and system read-only `WinSQLite3`).

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.14**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.13** 为对比基线，重点解决 Bilibili Index-Translate 翻译技术文档长图报错问题、全面增强 AI 原位翻译容错能力，并完成「内存策略」页面的全库命名与多语言一致性打磨：

sections.title: 修复 Bilibili Index-Translate 翻译报错并全面加固 AI 翻译链路
items: **彻底修复技术文档/长图触发上游拦截报错**：修复使用内置免密钥 **Bilibili Index-Translate** 翻译整页英文技术文档或含查询代码截图时偶发响应异常的问题。
**按模型档位自适应分批与超时保护**：针对 `Index-Translate-2B / 9B / 35B`、本机 Ollama/vLLM（自动单路防显存排队超时）及通用云端 OpenAI 兼容接口自动匹配最优批次大小与超时下限，整页多段翻译更稳更快。
**瞬态自动重试 + 异常二分自愈**：遇到临时超时、限流、网关波动或模型回复截断时，自动执行可瞬时取消的重试与自动二分拆批补译；即使单条离群内容仍被上游拒绝，也仅原样保留该条而不影响整页其他段落的翻译结果，彻底杜绝半页留白。
**连通性测试真实穿透**：在设置页点击「测试连通性」时始终发起真实网络探测，不再因命中本地会话缓存而出现换密钥或断网后的假通过。

sections.title: 技术文档截图原位翻译自动保护纯 SQL 语句
items: 在翻译技术文档、运维手册或数据库故障排查截图时，自动识别并原样保留可执行 SQL 查询语句及跨行条件续行，既避免代码被翻坏，又减少无效请求；同时确保普通英文句子正常翻译不被误拦。

sections.title: 翻译失败提示更准确（8 国语言全覆盖）
items: 细化免密钥通道临时异常、频率限制与 API 密钥鉴权失败三类提示文案；使用免密钥引擎遇到临时波动时不再误提示「检查密钥额度」，而是清晰引导稍后重试或切换其他翻译引擎。

sections.title: 「内存策略」全库命名、图标与 8 语种一致性收口
items: 配合上个版本已精简为只读回收时间表的页面定位，将侧边栏菜单、页面主副标题、「关于 / 通用设置」快捷入口、设置全文搜索及 8 套语言包和 README 文档统一对齐为 **「内存策略」** 与内存条图标，同步清理冗余旧文案并补齐多语种入口翻译。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.14** (compared against **v1.4.13**). This maintenance release hardens in-place AI screenshot translation across technical documents and large pages, fixes the Bilibili Index-Translate rejection on SQL-heavy pages, and aligns the streamlined Memory Policy UI and documentation across all 8 languages:

sections.title: Fixed Bilibili Index-Translate Rejection & End-to-End AI Translation Hardening
items: Resolved the issue where translating long or technical screenshots with the built-in keyless **Bilibili Index-Translate** preset could fail with an upstream request rejection.

Added model-aware batch sizing, smarter timeout floors, and safe concurrency across `Index-Translate-2B / 9B / 35B`, local Ollama/vLLM servers (single-stream protection against GPU queue timeouts), and cloud OpenAI-compatible APIs.

Added automatic one-time retry on transient network/gateway errors and automatic split-batch recovery: if a large page hits a timeout, content filter, or truncated reply, Tools3000 automatically splits and retries smaller chunks — isolating any single rejected line verbatim instead of failing the entire page.

Prevented partial or malformed AI responses from silently leaving blank translated regions, and ensured **Test Connection** in Settings always performs a live probe rather than reusing cached results.

sections.title: Preserve Raw SQL Queries in Technical Document Screenshots
items: Pure SQL queries (`SELECT / UPDATE / DELETE / INSERT` and wrapped multi-line `WHERE / AND` clauses) inside technical notes or database screenshots are now kept verbatim during in-place translation so runnable statements stay intact, while normal English sentences (such as `"Select an item from the list."`) continue translating naturally.

sections.title: Clearer Translation Error Messages (8 Languages)
items: Keyless engines (Bilibili Index-Translate, Edge, Google) and rate-limited requests now show accurate retry/switch-engine guidance instead of misleadingly asking you to check API key quota.

sections.title: Aligned "Memory Policy" Naming, Iconography & 8-Language Polish
items: Renamed the streamlined read-only schedule page from **Performance & Memory** to **Memory Policy** with a dedicated memory icon across the sidebar, page header, **About** / **General** shortcuts, settings search, and all 8 language packs and README guides.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.13**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.12** 为对比基线，集中回应多项高频社区与 Issue 反馈，围绕 **文件对话框一键直达、截图/贴图/演播室输入法防吞键、搜索框黑屏根治、免密钥 AI 翻译预设与搜索/性能页体验打磨** 带来全面升级：

sections.title: 文件对话框：一键直达活跃文件管理器目录 + 全可配置双快捷键
items: **一键直达当前目录（默认 `Ctrl+G`）**：在系统的「打开 / 保存」文件对话框内按下快捷键，立即跳转至你最近使用的文件管理器当前激活标签页所在路径，省去层层翻找目录的麻烦；原有「按应用记住上次打开/保存目录」完整保留。
**双快捷键全可自由配置，彻底脱离悬浮条限制**：内嵌快速搜索快捷键默认调整为 `Ctrl+Shift+G`；两项快捷键均可在 `设置 -> 文件对话框智能助手` 中独立自定义改键或清空禁用，即使关闭悬浮工具条也照常生效，且仅在文件对话框前台激活时生效，绝不干扰其他软件。
**多窗口多标签精准定位 & 第三方管理器/非标准框兼容**：
打开多个 Windows 11 多标签资源管理器窗口时，自动按最近使用顺序精准定位当前激活标签页（即使窗口刚刚最小化也能正确追溯）；
除 Windows 文件资源管理器外，同步兼容 **Total Commander、Directory Opus、XYplorer、Q-Dir、OneCommander、Files、Double Commander、FreeCommander、MultiCommander**；
显式按下快捷跳转键时，进一步安全兼容 **Qt** 与 **JetBrains** 系列软件的非标准文件对话框。

sections.title: 截图 / 桌面贴图 / 录屏演播室：非文字输入态彻底免疫输入法吞快捷键
items: **杜绝中/日/韩输入法拦截单键快捷键**：现在处于中文/日文/韩文输入法状态下，在截图选区、桌面贴图或录屏演播室里按 `R`、`Shift+R` 切换历史选区，或按 `C`、`E`、`S`、`Space`、`1~9` 等快捷键时，不再被输入法吞键，也不会弹出孤立的拼音候选框或把系统输入法中英文切乱。
**严守窗口级隔离，零全局污染**：绝不篡改你的系统全局输入法状态，退出截图切回微信、浏览器或编辑器后输入法 100% 保持原样；点击文字标注、贴图原位改字或演播室文字输入框时瞬间自动恢复输入法并精准跟随光标。

sections.title: 修复快捷键唤起文件搜索偶现黑屏的问题
items: 彻底解决在后台预载与长时间闲置休眠恢复边界下，按快捷键呼出文件搜索框偶现黑屏无界面的问题，确保每次呼出均清晰稳定渲染。

sections.title: 截图与划词翻译：新增 Bilibili Index-Translate（免费免密钥）一键预设
items: **默认极速双源保持不变**：开箱默认仍为低延迟的免费双源（Edge / Google），兼顾高频截图瞬译速度。

**一键免费体验高质量 AI 翻译**：在 `设置 -> 文字识别 -> 原位与划词翻译 -> OpenAI 兼容接口` 中新增 **Bilibili Index-Translate（免费免密钥）** 一键预设，无需登录与 API Key 即可使用，并支持快捷切换 `Index-Translate-2B`（极速）、`Index-Translate-9B`（均衡推荐）、`Index-Translate-35B-A3B`（旗舰）三档模型；切换至该免密钥预设时自动隔离你历史保存的私有密钥，绝不对外透传。
**推理模型全面兼容**：全局支持自动剥离推理模型偶发输出的思考过程片段，使用 DeepSeek-R1、本地 Qwen3 等模型进行截图原位翻译更加稳定。

sections.title: 文件搜索：纯离线默认分类零服务唤醒 & 「文档内容」自由拖拽排序
items: **应用/书签默认分类零唤醒**：将搜索默认分类设为「应用启动」或「浏览器书签」后，呼出搜索框不会再提前拉起后台全盘索引服务，日常使用更轻更快。
**分类栏更自由**：解除「文档内容」的默认固定位置限制，仅保留「全部」固定在首位，你可以将「文档内容」及其他分类自由拖拽排序（右键分类栏可随时恢复默认顺序）。

sections.title: 性能与内存页：极简聚焦回收时间表
items: 移除性能页顶部的实时资源监控面板与定时轮询，仅保留干净直观的「全链路内存生命周期与自动回收时间表」，界面更清爽、无额外观测负担。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.13** (compared against **v1.4.12**). This release focuses on real-world daily friction reported by the community — delivering Listary-style configurable file dialog quick-jump across Explorer tabs and third-party file managers, IME-proof single-key shortcuts during capture/pin/studio editing, a root-cause fix for search window black-screen wakeups, a built-in keyless AI translation preset, and cleaner search & performance ergonomics:

sections.title: **File Dialog Quick-Jump to Active File Manager & Configurable Dual Shortcuts**
items: Press `Ctrl+G` inside any standard Open/Save file dialog to jump straight to the active folder of your most recently used file manager tab (works even across multiple Windows 11 multi-tab Explorer windows or when the manager was just minimized).

Inline quick search inside file dialogs now uses `Ctrl+Shift+G` by default. Both shortcuts can be freely customized or cleared to disable under `Settings -> File Dialog Enhancer`, and both work even when the floating ribbon is turned off.

Broad third-party & non-standard compatibility: supports **Windows File Explorer**, **Total Commander**, **Directory Opus**, **XYplorer**, **Q-Dir**, **OneCommander**, **Files**, **Double Commander**, **FreeCommander**, and **MultiCommander**, plus explicit quick-jump support for **Qt** and **JetBrains** file dialogs (while keeping existing per-app folder memory intact).

sections.title: IME-Safe Single-Key Shortcuts Across Capture, Pin & Studio Canvases
items: Prevents Chinese/Japanese/Korean IMEs from hijacking non-text single-key shortcuts (`R`, `Shift+R`, `C`, `E`, `S`, `Space`, `1-9`, etc.) or popping up stray candidate boxes during screenshot selection, screen pinning, and recording studio editing.

Strictly window-scoped: your global system IME language and Chinese/English state are never altered when leaving capture. Switching into text annotations, in-place pin text editing, or studio text fields restores IME smoothly at the caret.

sections.title: **Fixed Search Window Black-Screen Reappearance on Hotkey Wakeup**
items: Resolved the race where hidden preloading and idle suspend could freeze the search surface before its first real visible frame, ensuring the search bar always renders crisply on hotkey summon.

sections.title: Built-In Keyless Bilibili Index-Translate Preset & Reasoning-Model Compatibility
items: Keeps the default Zero-Key Dual Free channel (Edge / Google) untouched for instant low-latency translation.

Added a one-click **Bilibili Index-Translate (Free · Keyless)** preset under `Settings -> OCR & Translate -> In-Place & Quick Translate -> OpenAI-Compatible API`, with quick model switching between `Index-Translate-2B` (Fast), `Index-Translate-9B` (Balanced), and `Index-Translate-35B-A3B` (Flagship). Saved private API keys are automatically isolated and never sent to this public endpoint. Also strips `<think>` blocks globally for reasoning models.

sections.title: **Zero-Warmup Offline Default Search Categories & Free Drag-to-Reorder for Document Content**
items: Summoning File Search when the default category is set to **Apps** or **Bookmarks** no longer wakes the background full-disk indexing service.
Unpinned **Document Content** on the search category bar (only **All** remains fixed in slot 1), allowing you to drag and reorder it anywhere freely (right-click the bar to restore default order).

sections.title: **Streamlined Performance & Memory Page**
items: Removed the top live telemetry monitor and periodic polling card from `Settings -> Performance & Memory`, leaving a clean, read-only overview of the full-chain memory lifecycle and auto-recycle schedule.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.12**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.11** 为对比基线，围绕高频效率场景中因人而异的操作习惯，为 **文件搜索、剪贴板历史、桌面贴图** 补齐 **9 项可自由定制的交互偏好**（默认 100% 沿用现有行为，老用户无任何学习成本），并修复了一处剪贴板自动粘贴设置未生效的问题：

sections.title: 文件搜索 (`Alt+Space`)：自由切换「工具窗常驻」或「Launcher 即用即走」
items: **失焦时自动隐藏**：开启后点击窗口外部即自动收起；内置智能避让，置顶状态、按空格呼出 QuickLook 预览、弹出右键/系统菜单或子对话框期间绝不误关；
**打开结果后自动隐藏**：开启后双击或按 `Enter` 打开文件、文件夹、应用、系统命令或书签成功后自动收起（置顶态或打开失败报错时保持展开）；
**重新呼出时自动清空上次搜索词**：开启后每次隐藏窗口再按 `Alt+Space` 呼出时自动清空旧关键词，直接切回可见窗口焦点时绝不误清。

sections.title: 剪贴板历史 (`Alt+V`)：全套窗口驻留与单击直贴定制 + 修复自动粘贴设置缺陷
items: **失焦时自动隐藏**（默认开启）：关闭后可像独立工作窗一样常驻桌面，且自动持续记住最近使用的外部目标窗口；
**粘贴或复制后自动隐藏**（默认开启）：关闭后支持连续多次粘贴不关窗，即便同时开启「自动粘贴」与「失焦自动隐藏」，在向目标窗发送 `Ctrl+V` 期间也会智能浮顶保护，避免被失焦隐藏误关；
**拖拽直贴后保持窗口展开**（默认开启）：关闭后拖拽条目投递到目标应用成功即自动收起（置顶时不受影响）；
**左键单击条目立即粘贴**（默认关闭）：追求极致少点一下时可一键开启，内置防双贴保护，且在勾选复选框、多选模式、`Ctrl`/`Shift` 多选、拖拽与编辑状态下自动豁免，绝不误触；
**修复「自动粘贴」与「默认纯文本粘贴」设置未完全生效的问题**：现在无论双击条目、按 `Enter`、`Alt+1..9` 快捷编号还是多选批量合并粘贴，都会严格遵循你的设置（关闭「自动粘贴」后仅写入系统剪贴板而不再强行发送 `Ctrl+V`）。

sections.title: 桌面贴图 (`F3`)：双击与鼠标中键动作随心定制，无缝兼容 Snipaste 肌肉记忆
items: **双击贴图空白处**：默认 `进入编辑 / 标注`，可选 `折叠 / 展开贴图` 或 `关闭贴图`；
**鼠标中键单击贴图**：默认 `恢复 1:1 原始大小`，可选 `关闭贴图` 或 `折叠 / 展开贴图`；
内置防误操作保护：处于折叠态时双击永远优先展开；原位改字编辑文字期间禁止双击或中键误关贴图；设为关闭/折叠时仍可正常左键拖选 OCR 文字。

sections.title: 设置搜索与 8 国语言全面同步
items: 以上 9 项新设置均已接入顶部全局设置搜索与简体中文、繁体中文、English、日本語、한국어、Русский、Português (Brasil)、Español 共 8 套语言界面。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.12** (compared against **v1.4.11**). This release introduces **9 customizable workflow behavior preferences** across File Search, Clipboard History, and Screen Pinning — keeping all existing defaults untouched while letting every user tune window dismissal and click actions to their own muscle memory:

sections.title: **Customizable File Search (`Alt+Space`) Window Behavior**
items: Added 3 independent toggles under `Settings -> File Search` (all off by default to preserve current behavior):

**Auto-hide when focus is lost**: Turns File Search into a launcher-style pop-up that hides when you click outside, while intelligently staying open for pinned mode, QuickLook previews, context/system menus, and child dialogs.
**Auto-hide after opening a result**: Automatically hides the search window after successfully opening a file, folder, app, command, or bookmark (stays open when pinned or if opening fails).
**Clear last query on re-open**: Starts with a fresh empty search box after the window was hidden and summoned again (never clears when simply switching focus back to a visible window).

sections.title: Customizable Clipboard History (`Alt+V`) Behavior & Auto-Paste Fix
items: Added 4 toggles under `Settings -> Clipboard` (preserving existing behavior by default):
**Auto-hide when focus is lost** (default: On)

**Auto-hide after pasting or copying** (default: On) — works seamlessly even when combined with *Auto-Paste* and *Auto-hide on blur*, keeping the panel floating safely while `Ctrl+V` is delivered so you can paste multiple items in a row.
**Keep panel open after drag-to-paste** (default: On) — turn off to dismiss automatically right after a successful drag delivery.
**Single-click item to paste immediately** (default: Off) — with built-in guards against double-paste, checkboxes, `Ctrl`/`Shift` multi-select, drag gestures, and inline editing.

**Fixed an Auto-Paste preference bug**: Double-clicking an item, pressing `Enter`, using `Alt+1..9`, or batch-merging items now strictly respects your **Auto-Paste** and **Plain Text by Default** settings instead of always forcing auto-paste.

sections.title: Customizable Screen Pinning (`F3`) Double-Click & Middle-Click Actions
items: Added 2 action selectors under `Settings -> Capture & Pin` for users coming from Snipaste or other pinning tools:
**Double-click blank area**: Default `Annotate / Edit`, optional `Fold / Unfold` or `Close Pin`.
**Middle-click pin**: Default `Reset 1:1 Scale`, optional `Close Pin` or `Fold / Unfold`.
Built-in safeguards always unfold a folded pin first on double-click and block accidental closure while editing in-place replaced text.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.11**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.10** 为对比基线，专项根治应用内一键覆盖更新时偶发弹出「安装程序无法自动关闭所有应用程序」报错框的问题：

sections.title: 彻底消除应用内一键更新「无法自动关闭所有应用程序」报错弹窗
items: **向下兼容所有存量旧版本一键升级**：安装包在进入准备阶段（Windows Restart Manager 扫描）之前，即抢先等待旧进程优雅保存退出并自动清理残留文件锁，确保从 `v1.4.10` 及更早版本点击软件内一键升级也能全程零报错弹窗、自动平滑覆盖并拉起新版；
**关闭冗余 Restart Manager 覆盖参数**：应用内更新与 CLI 静默安装统一改由安装器原生清场与拉起逻辑接管，不再因命令行覆盖配置而误弹 Restart Manager 警告框。

sections.title: 加固主程序退出阶段防僵死守护
items: 将退出防僵死看门狗前置至 `CoUninitialize()` 之前（在全部配置落盘、自动备份、热键注销、单实例互斥体释放及日志刷盘完成后启动），并补齐顶层退出熔断保护，彻底杜绝 WebView2/COM 卸载阻塞导致后台残留无窗口进程锁住安装目录。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.11** (compared against **v1.4.10**). This hotfix release eliminates the "Setup was unable to automatically close all applications" prompt during in-app updates and hardens clean process exit:

sections.title: Zero-Prompt In-App Auto-Updates (Including Upgrades from Older Versions)
items: Fixed an issue where clicking **Install Update** in Settings could trigger Windows Restart Manager's *"Setup was unable to automatically close all applications"* dialog before the installer's built-in process cleanup ran.

Installer silent/auto-update mode now cleanly waits for and clears any lingering old `Tools3000.exe` processes **before** entering the preparing phase, so even users upgrading from `v1.4.10` or earlier experience a completely smooth, prompt-free in-place update.

Switched in-app updater and CLI install parameters to `/NOCLOSEAPPLICATIONS /NORESTARTAPPLICATIONS` so process handover and relaunch are managed exclusively by the installer without Restart Manager interference.

sections.title: Zombie-Proof Process Exit Guard
items: Moved the exit watchdog ahead of `CoUninitialize()` (after all settings, backups, hotkeys, and logs are safely flushed and the single-instance mutex is released) and added an 8-second outer shutdown fuse, preventing WebView2/COM teardown stalls from ever leaving a windowless process locking files in the install directory.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.10**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.9** 为对比基线，带来**录屏演播室全格式高压缩与运镜重构**、**截图文本框 8 方向独立拉伸**、**机械硬盘搜索全链路提速与内存直降 37%**、**性能与内存页真实工作集修复**及**剪贴板批量删除根治**五大核心升级（感谢 Linux.do `@zg2qxy`；`#29`, `@xwshan`）：

sections.title: 录屏演播室：全 6 格式稳定导出、画质保真体积直降 92%+、智能运镜不再裁切输入框
items: **彻底修复 WebM (VP9) 导出失败并完善全格式错误提示**：内置 `libx264`、`libvpx (VP9/VP8)` 与 `libopus` 编码器，实现 **WebM (VP9 + Opus)**、**MP4 (H.264 / HEVC)**、**WebP 动图**、**微信直发 GIF** 与 **高清 GIF** 全 6 格式开箱即用；目标文件被其他程序占用时自动顺延新文件名救援，失败时明确提示具体原因而非笼统报错；

**桌面专属高压缩算法（清晰小字 + 超小体积）**：引入桌面文字锐利度保护的 CRF/CQ 编码、5 秒长 GOP、静止画面 VFR 智能抽帧以及 GIF/WebP 静止帧时长合并。实测 55 秒 `3456x2086`（`51.5 MB`）原片导出 `1080P` 推荐档后：**WebM (VP9) 仅 `3.66 MB`（省 92.9%）**、**MP4 (H.264) 仅 `3.75 MB`（省 92.7%）**、**紧凑 MP4 仅 `2.94 MB`（省 94.3%）**，文字边缘清晰锐利；
**重构自动运镜聚焦逻辑，彻底告别上半屏输入被裁切**：修复在屏幕上半部分搜索框/输入框打字时，自动运镜偏向屏幕中心放大导致正在输入的内容移出画面的问题，放大期间始终精准锚定输入焦点与操作意图，确保输入区全程完整可见。

sections.title: 截图文本框标注：支持 8 方向独立拉宽、拉长与实时流式换行
items: 文本框控制手柄全面升级为**四边独立胶囊手柄 + 四角等比缩放圆点手柄**：
拖动**左右边中点手柄**可独立拉宽或收窄文本框，文字按新宽度实时自动折行重排且**字号保持不变**；
拖动**上下边中点手柄**可独立拉长或压紧文本框高度；
拖动**四个角手柄**继续按比例同步缩放字号与整体框体；
**双击任意四边中点手柄**可一键恢复自动贴合文字内容尺寸，完整支持撤销/重做（`Ctrl+Z` / `Ctrl+Y`）。

sections.title: 全盘搜索与机械硬盘专项突破：内存直降 37%、消除首次打开黑屏与 90% 磁盘飙升
items: **搜索服务内存直降 37.4% 与机械盘平滑快照**：采用紧凑 40 字节索引记录与 ASCII / 原生 UTF-16 双轨存储，近 300 万真实全盘文件专用内存由 **315 MB 降至 197 MB**（28 类全语法结果数量 100% 守恒）；索引快照改为 2 MB 流式分块写出并针对机械盘平滑节流（每 4 MB 让出 12 ms），彻底消除 150–250 MB 临时内存峰值与后台写盘导致的机械盘 90% 磁盘飙升；
**根治机械盘每次新搜索卡顿数秒与偶发闪现「未找到」**：回收站与历史路径过滤 100% 改为纯内存执行，磁盘属性实时校验严格收敛至首屏视口（机械盘 50 ms 硬预算），大结果集提速 5x–100x；本地应用清单升级为 10 分钟后台无感热更新，搜索框唤起即先呈本地应用与命令，彻底消除“先闪未找到几秒后才出结果”；
**彻底消除机械盘首次打开搜索框纯色黑屏**：搜索窗在 WebView2 完成真实首帧渲染前保持原生加载提示可见，且不再对尚未完成首帧绘制的后台预热窗口过早挂起冻结，彻底消除首次按 `Alt+Space` 时的数秒纯色黑屏；

**更稳健的后台服务闲置水位守卫与完整诊断日志**：闲置期间若后台文件变更（如 Docker / Syncthing）再次将服务工作集顶高至 64 MB 以上，将按冷却周期自动温和再修剪；退出主程序前若索引服务在线且非全速常驻模式，也会顺带执行一次轻度瘦身（完整保留搜索服务默认会话常驻策略不变）；设置页销毁周期按介质自适应（固态 5 分钟 / 机械 15 分钟）且不再盲扫休眠盘符；导出诊断日志同步附带 `Tools3000_Service.log` 尾部以便快速排障。

sections.title: 修复「性能与内存」页数据偏差与静默回收按钮反馈
items: **「专用工作集内存」与任务管理器 1:1 对齐**：修复此前误将进程虚拟提交量（`PrivateUsage`）展示为「专用工作集内存」导致数值高于总物理工作集、且回收后数字纹丝不动的缺陷，现统一采集系统真实 `PrivateWorkingSetSize`；
**「立即执行静默回收」立竿见影**：点击后不再受异步延迟与旧采样缓存影响，立即执行堆紧缩与工作集修剪并实时刷新回落后的内存读数；若全盘搜索服务当前已在线，也会同步执行一次轻度瘦身（未运行时绝不拉起服务）。

sections.title: 彻底修复 `Alt+V` 剪贴板批量删除「实际只删了一条」
items: **复选框独立勾选不清空选区**：多选后直接点击左侧任意条目的复选框区域即可独立加选或取消，不再因松开 `Ctrl` 键而清空已有选区；
**右侧详情底栏「删除」按钮多选联动**：勾选多条记录时，详情区底部的「删除」按钮自动切换为红色高亮的「删除 (N)」并触发批量删除，避免误触只删当前焦点单条；
**支持 `Alt+V` → `Ctrl+A` → `Delete` 一键全删**：当搜索框为空且已勾选多条记录时，直接按 `Delete` 键即可批量删除全部所选条目。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.10** (compared against **v1.4.9**). This feature and performance release brings major upgrades across **Screen Recording Studio**, **Screenshot Text Markup**, **Clipboard Batch Operations**, **Performance Telemetry**, and **Mechanical HDD / Windows 10 LTSC Search Performance** (thanks to Linux.do `@zg2qxy` and `#29`, `@xwshan`):

sections.title: Screen Recording Studio: All-Format Export Reliability, ~92% Smaller Files & Smart Auto-Zoom
items: **Full Native 6-Format Export**: Shipped built-in `libx264`, `libvpx (VP9/VP8)`, and `libopus` encoders so **WebM (VP9 + Opus)**, **MP4 (H.264 / HEVC)**, **Animated WebP**, **Discord / Slack / WeChat Compact GIF**, and **HD GIF** all export reliably out of the box with clear localized diagnostics and automatic filename rescue if the target file is locked.

**High-Efficiency Desktop Compression**: Adopted CRF/CQ desktop-text-preserving encoding, 5-second GOPs, static-frame VFR decimation, and GIF/WebP duplicate-frame duration merging. On a real 55-second 3456x2086 (51.5 MB) desktop recording, exports shrink by **92–94%** (`WebM VP9 1080p24`: **3.66 MB**, `MP4 H.264 1080p30`: **3.75 MB**, `Compact MP4`: **2.94 MB**) while keeping crisp UI text.

**Auto-Zoom Never Crops Upper-Screen Typing**: Overhauled auto-zoom clustering, UIA control filtering, and real-time focus tracking so typing into search bars or inputs in the upper half of the screen stays cleanly framed instead of zooming into the screen center and cutting off your text.

sections.title: Screenshot Text Box: 8-Way Independent Resizing & Live Reflow
items: Text markup boxes now feature distinct capsule handles on all four edges alongside corner scale handles: drag **left/right** to widen or narrow the box with live word-wrap reflow (font size unchanged), drag **top/bottom** to adjust box height independently, drag **corners** to scale font size and dimensions proportionally, or **double-click** any edge handle to snap back to auto-fit. Full Undo/Redo fidelity preserved.

sections.title: Mechanical HDD & Search Engine Overhaul (`-37%` RAM, 5x–100x Faster Queries, Zero First-Open Black Screen)
items: **-37.4% Search Index RAM & Smooth HDD Snapshots**: Compact 40-byte records and dual-track ASCII / native UTF-16 storage drop real-world index memory on ~3M files from **315 MB to 197 MB** with 100% identical results across all 28 syntax categories; streaming 2 MiB snapshot persistence with smooth HDD pacing (`4 MiB / 12 ms` yield) eliminates memory spikes and disk-queue saturation.

**Instant HDD Searches & Zero Stale "No Files Found"**: Moved Recycle Bin/Recent filtering 100% in-memory and bounded disk attribute hydration to the visible top viewport (50 ms HDD budget); upgraded local app/command catalogs to 10-minute background SWR caching so local apps appear immediately without flashing empty states.

**Eliminated First-Open Search Black Screen**: Search window now keeps its native loading surface visible until the first rendered frame commits and avoids prematurely suspending an unpainted preloaded WebView.

**Smarter Idle Service Memory & Complete Diagnostic Logs**: Added idle high-watermark re-trimming (re-compacting working set if background USN churn from Docker/Syncthing pushes idle usage back above 64 MiB), gentle non-stopping trim on host exit (preserving the session-resident contract), adaptive Settings teardown (**5 min SSD / 15 min HDD**), and automatic inclusion of `Tools3000_Service.log` in exported diagnostic logs.

sections.title: Performance & Memory Page: Accurate Private Working Set & Instant Quiet Trim
items: Fixed the "Private Working Set" metric reading virtual commit size (`PrivateUsage`) instead of true `PrivateWorkingSetSize`, now matching Windows Task Manager 1:1.

Clicking **Run Quiet Trim Now** now trims immediately, refreshes real-time telemetry right away, and gently trims the search service if it is already running (without ever starting a stopped service).

sections.title: Clipboard (`Alt+V`) Batch Delete Fix
items: Fixed three interaction issues that caused batch delete to remove only a single item: clicking item checkboxes now toggles selection independently without clearing existing selections; the detail panel's **Delete** button automatically switches to batch delete (`Delete (N)`) whenever multiple entries are checked; and pressing `Delete` after `Ctrl+A` with an empty search box deletes all selected entries directly.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.9**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.8** 为对比基线，紧急修复 PP-OCRv6 离线模型包下载校验失败问题，加固全部 4 类离线 AI 模型下载完整性，并从内核 I/O 层消除搜索服务触发安全软件「浏览器密码保护盾」误报：

sections.title: 彻底修复 `PP-OCRv6` 离线模型下载校验失败并加固全部 4 类模型包下载
items: **修复 `PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx` / `PP-OCRv6_rec_medium.onnx` 下载后误判损坏**：根治 `v1.4.8` 下载完成识别模型后误调用旧版 OpenCV DNN 试解析导致报错 `Failed to download or verify PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx` 的问题，全新安装、从旧版 `v4` 一键升级至 `PP-OCRv6` 以及下载高精度增强包均可在国内直连秒速稳定完成；
**全 4 类模型包完整防截断校验**：为 **PP-OCRv6 核心包**、**+73 MB 高精度增强包**、**韩/俄/阿/泰 4 国扩展包** 与 **MI-GAN 512 原位改字修复模型** 全面补齐 HTTP `Content-Length` 精确字节防截断断言与完整 ONNX `ModelProto` 结构校验（同时消除校验瞬间约 200 MB 内存峰值）；
**修复升级失败静默吞错提示**：修复老版 `v4` 用户点击「升级至 PP-OCRv6」遇到异常时错误 Toast 未弹出的问题；
**红章压字与代码行号槽识别优化**：升级红章穿透为光学反混合还原（避免半透明红章覆盖的黑字被漂淡断行），并新增代码编辑器左侧孤立行号槽隔离，拖选折行 JSON/代码复制不再夹带行号。

sections.title: 搜索服务对浏览器敏感凭据文件零句柄触碰
items: 在本地 NTFS 索引服务 `Tools3000_Service.exe` 的 USN 实时属性刷新、后台目录水合、搜索结果属性查询与全文内容搜索 4 条全链路中，显式跳过主流浏览器（Chrome / Edge / Brave / Opera / Vivaldi / Firefox 等）的密码、Cookie、密钥库文件（`Login Data`、`Web Data`、`Cookies`、`Local State`、`logins.json`、`key4.db`、`cookies.sqlite` 等）及 Windows 凭据目录；
从系统文件句柄层面彻底做到“连属性都不触碰”，消除部分安全软件「浏览器密码保护盾」误报弹窗，同时不影响正常工作目录与文档搜索。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.9** (compared against **v1.4.8**). This rapid maintenance release fixes PP-OCRv6 offline model download verification, hardens integrity checks across all four downloadable AI model packs, and prevents security software false positives on browser profile folders:

sections.title: PP-OCRv6 & AI Model Pack Download Verification Fix
items: Fixed a verification bug in `v1.4.8` where `PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx` and `PP-OCRv6_rec_medium.onnx` failed integrity checks right after downloading (`Failed to download or verify PP-OCRv6_rec_small.onnx`).

Replaced the legacy OpenCV DNN probe with full ONNX `ModelProto` structural validation, embedded dictionary verification, and exact HTTP `Content-Length` truncation checks across all four downloadable packs (**PP-OCRv6 Small**, **PP-OCRv6 Rec Medium**, **4 Multilingual Extension Packs**, and **MI-GAN 512 AI Inpaint**).
Fixed a UI feedback gap where a failed upgrade from legacy `PP-OCRv4` to `PP-OCRv6` silently hid the error toast.

Improved red-stamp inverse alpha unblending (preventing black text under translucent stamps from splitting) and isolated standalone code-editor line-number gutters so copying wrapped JSON/code never pulls leading line numbers into the selection.

sections.title: Zero Handle Touch on Browser Credential Files
items: Hardened `Tools3000_Service.exe` (local NTFS filename indexing service) to explicitly skip metadata handles (`OpenFileById` / `GetFileAttributesExW`) and full-text content scanning for browser credential/session files (`Login Data`, `Web Data`, `Cookies`, `Local State`, `logins.json`, `key4.db`, `cookies.sqlite`, etc.) and browser profile / Windows credential directories across Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Firefox, and derivatives.
Completely eliminates antivirus "browser password shield" false-positive alerts while keeping normal file search unaffected.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.8**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.7** 为对比基线，带来离线文字识别引擎跨代升级至 PP-OCRv6、截图文字标注自动换行、文件搜索多路径排除、Win10 LTSC 与机械硬盘深度适配，以及更克制的剪贴板策略与图片文件快捷贴图：

sections.title: 离线文字识别跨代升级至 `PP-OCRv6` 与 65+ 语种生态
items: **默认核心引擎升级为 `PP-OCRv6 Small`（约 30.3 MB）**：内置词表原生覆盖简/繁中文、英文、日文、法/德/西/葡等 50 种语言，复杂表格、多栏文档与高密截图识别准确度显著跃升，同时识别速度反而更快；已安装旧版 `PP-OCRv4` 的用户可在 `设置 -> 文本识别与翻译 -> 离线引擎与模型包` 一键无痛升级，升级完成后自动清理历史冗余模型文件；
**可选高精度精修包同步升级为 `PP-OCRv6 Rec Medium`（73.1 MB）**：体积较旧版 v4 精修包更小，配合全新通用信噪比与几何保真双重护栏，常规清晰截图零额外耗时，仅对疑难低置信度行按需触发二阶精修；当触发精修或自动切换语种时，会在结果窗标题栏与提示条展示轻量进度反馈，快速识别全程静默零打扰；
**按需扩展语种包与原位翻译全语种解锁**：更新纯 Apache-2.0 的 **韩语 / 俄语（西里尔）/ 阿拉伯语 / 泰语** 四大扩展包（修复全装 4 包时泰语偶发被跳过的问题，并补齐阿拉伯语 RTL 从右至左逻辑阅读序还原）；Windows 系统 OCR 同步新增法、德、越、阿、泰等语种选项；**原位翻译**同步解锁阿拉伯语、泰语及越南语变音文本识别，跨语种界面翻译开箱即用。

sections.title: 截图文字标注遇边界自动换行
items: 在截图内输入或粘贴长段文字时，触达选区右边界自动按词软换行（英文与数字单词不断腰、超长网址自动折断、中文避头标点保护），且**绝不在原文中注入假换行符**；
拖动文本框或拉宽/收窄选区时文字自动流式重排，靠近右/下边缘点击或放大字号触底时自动温和礼让上抬，中文输入法候选框、方向键换行与鼠标划词高亮全面对齐。

sections.title: 文件搜索（`Alt + Space`）：自定义多路径排除文件夹
items: 支持在 `设置 -> 文件搜索` 与搜索框右上角「视图设置」中自由管理多个排除目录，提供原生系统文件夹选择器与多行/分号批量粘贴；
在搜索结果列表右键新增一键 **「排除此文件夹 / 排除所在文件夹」**，立即隐藏并支持 Toast 一键撤销；严格按目录边界精准屏蔽（例如排除 `D:\视频` 绝不误伤 `D:\视频素材`），同时覆盖文件名搜索、全文内容搜索与 CLI / MCP 接口。

sections.title: 修复 Windows 10 LTSC 搜索黑屏与机械硬盘 100% 占用卡顿
items: **机械硬盘物理拓扑感知与温和低优扫描**：自动识别物理磁盘与机械盘（HDD），同一块物理机械盘上的多个分区改为低优先级后台串行扫描（杜绝多分区并发寻道撕裂磁头），跳过机械盘全盘随机寻道预热并优化快照写入，彻底根治机械盘搜索卡死与磁盘占满问题；
**消除冷启动搜索黑屏**：为搜索窗口补齐原生加载/状态界面与异常自动重载自愈能力，并将冷启动阶段的后台索引服务预热错峰延后至界面渲染就绪后执行，弹出更跟手、不再出现空白黑屏。

sections.title: 更克制的截图剪贴板策略与「复制图片文件按 `F3` 直接贴图」
items: **双关零污染剪贴板**：关闭「自动复制到剪贴板」后，无论「自动保存到文件」是否开启，点选完成、保存、贴图或原位翻译均 **绝不擅自覆写用户原有剪贴板**（仅主动按 `Ctrl + C` 或点击复制按钮时写入），看完翻译即走不再破坏原有剪贴板工作流；

**图片文件 `Ctrl + C` -> `F3` 直接贴图**：在 Windows 资源管理器、桌面、Tools3000 搜索框、Everything、微信/QQ 或任意第三方文件管理器中 `Ctrl + C` 复制图片文件（支持 PNG / JPG / WebP / BMP / TIFF / GIF 首帧 / ICO / HEIC / AVIF，保留透明通道与照片正确方向），随时按下 `F3` 即可直接贴图到桌面；一次多选多张图片文件后，连续按 `F3` 可依次逐张贴出。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.8** (compared against **v1.4.7**). This release delivers a major offline OCR upgrade to **PP-OCRv6** with expanded multilingual support, smart auto-wrapping for screenshot text annotations, multi-path custom folder exclusions for File Search, a complete fix for Windows 10 LTSC black-screen and HDD indexing stalls, a non-intrusive clipboard delivery policy, and direct `Ctrl + C` -> `F3` image file pinning:

sections.title: **Next-Gen Offline OCR (`PP-OCRv6`) & 65+ Language Ecosystem**
items: **Faster & More Accurate Default Engine (`PP-OCRv6 Small`, ~30.3 MB)**: Covers 50 languages out of the box (Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, and more) with noticeably higher accuracy and faster speed than the previous v4 pack. Existing users can upgrade in one click under `Settings -> OCR & Translate -> Offline Engine & Model Packs` with automatic cleanup of legacy model files.

**Optional High-Precision Refinement Pack (`PP-OCRv6 Rec Medium`, 73.1 MB)**: Smaller than the previous v4 refinement pack while delivering stronger recognition on complex/dense tables and code. Dual quality guardrails ensure everyday crisp screenshots stay instant with zero extra overhead; when slow-path refinement or auto language switching kicks in, a subtle live status indicator appears without interrupting your workflow.

**Refreshed On-Demand Language Packs & Expanded In-Place Translation**: Updated Apache-2.0 language packs for **Korean, Cyrillic (Russian), Arabic (with logical RTL order restoration), and Thai** (fixing multi-pack probe timeouts), plus expanded Windows OCR options (`fr-FR`, `de-DE`, `vi-VN`, `ar-SA`, `th-TH`). In-place screenshot translation now also recognizes Arabic, Thai, and Vietnamese scripts seamlessly.

sections.title: **Smart Auto-Wrap for Screenshot Text Annotations**
items: Typing or pasting text inside a screenshot now wraps cleanly at the selection boundary without inserting fake line breaks into your text—keeping English words intact, gracefully breaking long URLs, protecting CJK leading punctuation, and reflowing smoothly when you drag the text box or resize the selection. Smart edge nudging and bottom-edge lift prevent clipped text while keeping IME candidate windows and cursor selection aligned.

sections.title: **File Search (`Alt + Space`): Multi-Path Custom Folder Exclusions**
items: Exclude one or many folders via the native folder picker, batch paste, or right-clicking any search result (`Exclude this folder` / `Exclude parent folder` with instant undo). Strict path-boundary matching (excluding `D:\Movies` never hides `D:\Movies2`) applies consistently across filename search, full-text content search, and the CLI / MCP interfaces.

sections.title: **Windows 10 LTSC Search Black-Screen & Mechanical HDD High-I/O Fix**
items: Automatically detects physical disk topology and rotational HDDs: partitions sharing the same mechanical drive are scanned sequentially at very-low background I/O priority, full-disk random-seek metadata pre-hydration is skipped on HDDs, and snapshot writes avoid per-chunk blocking flushes—eliminating 100% disk freezes.

Added a native state backdrop and automatic recovery for the Search window so cold startup or WebView2 issues never leave a blank black screen, while staggering service warmup until the UI finishes rendering.

sections.title: Non-Intrusive Clipboard Policy & `Ctrl + C` -> `F3` Image File Pinning
items: **Zero Unwanted Clipboard Overwrites**: When **Auto-copy to clipboard** is turned off (even if **Auto-save to file** is also off), completing, saving, pinning, or translating a screenshot will never silently overwrite your existing clipboard—only explicit `Ctrl + C` / Copy writes to the clipboard.

**Copy Any Image File -> Press `F3` to Pin**: Press `Ctrl + C` on one or more image files in Windows File Explorer, Desktop, Tools3000 Search, Everything, or any file manager (supports PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, TIFF, GIF first frame, ICO, HEIC, AVIF with transparency and EXIF orientation preserved), then press `F3` anywhere to pin them directly to your screen. Press `F3` repeatedly to step through multi-selected image files.

zh.summary: 欢迎升级至 **Tools3000 v1.4.7**。本版本以已正式发布的 **v1.4.6** 为对比基线，聚焦系统兼容性稳定性、长时静置内存曲线治理与剪贴板拖拽体验打磨：

sections.title: 彻底修复 Windows Server 2019 启动约 5 秒托盘闪退
items: 修复在 Windows Server 2019（Build 17763）安装 WebView2 后启动 Tools3000，出现「启动成功」提示约 5 秒后托盘图标意外闪退的问题；
启动后的静默内存整理改为在 WebView2 初始化完成前自动顺延，并收敛堆整理范围仅作用于自身进程堆，确保服务器系统与慢速虚拟机同样稳定常驻。

sections.title: 长时静置内存稳态治理（告别 `3 MB <-> 40+ MB` 锯齿波动）
items: **手势全屏画布零预占 + 30 秒闲置自动回收**：冷启动不再提前占用高分屏/4K 全屏手势显存表面，改为首次划动手势时按需瞬时分配，闲置满 30 秒自动释放并回收显存缓存；跟手速度零损耗，同时消除冷态与用后常驻的数十 MB 显存占用；
**后台静默降噪与温和水位巡检**：未打开「性能与内存」页面时自动放缓后台监控采样频率（由 2 秒降至 30 秒），同步降低前台全屏状态检查频率，大幅削减无操作期间的后台软缺页增长；主循环增加温和的闲置内存水位巡检，长时后台挂机内存曲线更加平稳（实机冷态稳态工作集约 `2.7–5.5 MB`）。

sections.title: 修复剪贴板（`Alt + V`）拖入图片或文件至 Antigravity / 浏览器出现双图重复
items: 修复从剪贴板面板拖拽图片或文件到 Antigravity 对话框、Cursor 或现代浏览器（Chrome / Edge / Firefox）时，因系统原生拖放成功后又重复触发一次回退粘贴、导致同一张图片被插入两份的问题；
纯文本绕过网页文件上传遮罩层、单条 `http(s)://` 网址生成 `@Link` 卡片以及跨权限窗口兜底直贴体验均完整保留。

sections.title: 安全依赖升级与 8 国语言文档精修
items: 升级前端多语言核心依赖 `i18next` 至 `26.7.2`，消除 Dependabot `#42` 告警（当前仓库开放安全告警归零）；
同步完成全 8 语种说明文档与 13 核功能总览海报的跨地域本地化精修。

en.summary: Welcome to **Tools3000 v1.4.7** (compared against **v1.4.6**). This focused stability and memory-hygiene release fixes a startup crash on **Windows Server 2019**, eliminates background idle working-set oscillation, resolves duplicate image insertion when dragging from Clipboard History into AI IDEs or browsers, and clears all open security advisories:

sections.title: Windows Server 2019 Startup Crash Fix
